occurrences.statement: A snapshot edit is an owner-reviewed draft change to imported text; static/integrity checks may be displayed but are not behavioral approval. A validated change requires relevant application tests and independent evidence on exact source/candidate/test/image digests. Deployment additionally requires target grant, digest-bound review, recovery plan, fresh health baseline and provider read-back. A mutable boolean “tests passed” without binding cannot satisfy these contracts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Fields: receipt_id, tenant_id, project_id, run_id, task_id, attempt_id, candidate_digest, source_digest, image_digest, test_manifest_digest, execution_identity, attestation_ref, started_at, completed_at, fence_epoch, cancellation_generation, exit_status, test_results_uri, resource_usage, cleanup_status and signature. The verifier validates identity/attestation/signature outside the worker; an unverified self-assertion is not sufficient. Accept only current leased attempt and matching immutable inputs; duplicates are idempotent, changed payload under the same ID conflicts. Store rejection evidence without overwriting the current result.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The root reservation owns total approved spend. A cross-cell allocation first creates a durable debit and allocation ID in root authority; only a signed grant for that ID enables child dispatch. An uncertain delivery may be retried with the same ID, not a second allocation. Settlement receipts deduplicate by allocation/operation/provider request. Return unspent balance only after terminal reconciliation. Ledger accounting and resource reservation are separate systems with explicit mappings.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: States: requested, denied_for_use, enumerating_derivations, purging, verifying, completed or blocked_by_named_obligation. Immediate policy tombstone precedes index purge. Track generation/cell/subscriber receipts, backup restore handling and model-training lineage. Completion reports what was erased, what remains lawfully restricted and why. Define measured convergence SLOs before selling them; immediate deny targets and purge times are not yet achieved.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A release pins source/candidate, build materials, image, tests, evaluators, policy/grants, target, cost reservation, model/prompt/genome versions and rollback/forward-recovery artifacts. Deployment/failover/research releases use different risk policies but the same provenance discipline. Compatibility checks include API/event/ontology/embedding generations and long-running workflow versions.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: For each task record requirement ID, exact source revision, test environment, inputs/fixtures, observed outputs, negative cases, artifacts/provider receipts, owner, date and remaining limitations. A fixture test verifies its fixture contract; a live integration verifies its provider path; a fault drill verifies its measured failure envelope. Preserve all three labels. No approval or review waives a critical access, secret, isolation, financial or ownership invariant.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Founder owns value/scope/funding; platform/runtime owns durable execution; security owns policy/isolation/provenance; data owns memory/retrieval/withdrawal; research owns evaluation quality; experience owns consent/accessibility/correction; SRE owns restore/incident/capacity; finance owns usage/accounting; enterprise operations owns contracts/support. A small team may hold multiple roles, but high-risk independent reviews cannot collapse into the candidate author signing their own work.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The first milestone is the authorized behavior-tested draft-PR loop. Next: concurrent orchestration/evidence hardening and scoped data controls. Then: team operations/billing/support, richer intelligence, telemetry-backed healing, tested cells and evaluated ecosystem/evolution. Independent research/contracts continue while live provider/host prerequisites remain unavailable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: # Part II — Forty required outputs
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: OmniDev Swarm is an evidence-driven engineering intelligence platform. Its commercial wedge is durable repository understanding plus validated, reviewable changes. Its long-term scope remains cross-domain orchestration, research, simulation and evolution. The current owner-private application is a foundation, not the million-tenant target.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The Build Bible replaces ambiguity with three records: normative target design, actual implementation evidence and open engineering work. The Final Omniscient Audit adds twenty explicit controls; the Super Audit applies eleven hypothetical company lenses. Eight hostile review roles are represented in the review dossiers. New findings do not disappear because a corresponding paragraph already exists in a design. A specification can resolve a design contradiction while leaving its runtime defect open.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: - [PRODUCTION-ARCHITECTURE/18-verification-and-production-gates.md](../PRODUCTION-ARCHITECTURE/18-verification-and-production-gates.md)
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: “Living intelligence” means continuously maintained models and learning workflows, not consciousness or guaranteed intelligence growth. “Nothing isolated” means entities connect to known owning scope and evidence-backed relationships; missing links are gaps, not invented facts. “Unlimited expansion” means extensible schemas and specialist registration, never infinite runtime or spending.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: All original specialist domains and integration families remain in scope. Staging protects the full vision from premature operational commitments: retain future capabilities in the roadmap and backlog while shipping narrow, valuable, verified workflows. Product truth is a differentiator: show what ran, what was only proposed, what is unknown and what requires consent.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use a modular control plane initially, with logical service contracts that can later split by scale, isolation and ownership. Core domains are identity/workspaces, policy, connections/vault, ingestion, source intelligence, graph/memory/retrieval, AgentOS, model gateway, tool broker, sandbox control, change delivery, findings, healing, twins, research/futures, marketplace, billing, analytics and experience. Each owns its authoritative aggregate; cross-domain updates use APIs and an outbox.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Global edge routes requests to the project home cell. Global services contain non-content placement and public release metadata; tenant-private sources stay in approved residency. A per-residency authority domain grants single-writer epochs. The global locator cannot mint write authority. A scope transfer must fence its predecessor and preserve durable operation identities.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Models generate proposals; deterministic services authorize and enforce. Tasks reference immutable snapshots and capability manifests. Long work is asynchronous, cancellable and budgeted. Derived graph/search/score views may lag and expose watermarks. Intelligence outages should degrade panels without corrupting task authority. Sensitive actions stop when policy, grants, financial authority or ownership becomes uncertain.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Deploy one bounded region before claiming multi-cloud resilience. Regional cells use multiple zones where sold availability requires it; execution pools are separate from API/control workloads. Hostile repository code needs a reviewed isolation boundary such as disposable microVMs or equivalent attested isolation. Docker on a dedicated host can serve a narrowly evaluated owner-only stage, but is not automatically a public hostile multi-tenant boundary.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: IaC must pin versions and image digests, separate environment identities and include deny-default egress. Package installation uses reviewed mirrors and isolated builds. Restore bootstrap must not depend circularly on unavailable policy/KMS/directory services. Protect independent recovery credentials and test their use. Cloud portability is a capability and migration contract, not identical behavior across providers.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Claims use compare-and-swap version, attempt ID, lease token, fencing epoch and cancellation generation. Heartbeats cannot resurrect expired authority. A worker result binds the exact candidate digest, test manifest, source revision, image and attempt. Result acceptance checks current job state and authority in one transaction. The current shared-bearer report interface lacks that full binding and remains a release blocker.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: PostgreSQL and immutable source journal preserve authoritative claim history; Neo4j materializes queryable partitions. Cross-project traversal occurs only through authorized bounded federation. An owning-scope edge connects incompletely mapped entities; a gap marks unknown relationships. Never conflate similar names across tenants. Evidence-backed entity merges preserve aliases and undo history.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Ontology changes use registered semantic versions, shadow generations, translation views and query regression tests. Graph queries require time cutoff, traversal/path limits, policy filtering and current access recheck. Query counts, hidden neighbors and cache keys must not reveal inaccessible objects. Partial extraction reports coverage and failed parsers rather than an optimistic health score.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Session, Agent, Swarm, Project, Organization, Global Pattern, Innovation and Future memory share a typed evidence envelope with explicit scope. Decisions preserve rationale, actor/time, alternatives, risks, expected and actual outcomes and lessons. Research evidence and scenario forecasts are distinct records. Retrieval applies current authorization even to historical data.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Memory consolidation is versioned and reversible. Conflicts remain visible with supporting/contrary evidence. Indefinite retention is a policy aspiration constrained by rights, deletion, residency and cost. Backups are not permission to resurrect deleted source. A withdrawal registry immediately denies use, then purges derivations, vectors, summaries, caches and permitted archives through a tracked convergence workflow.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Global learning uses public/licensed or consented privacy-reviewed patterns. Redaction alone does not establish anonymity. Training manifests track source rights; trained models need an explicit withdrawal response, possibly retirement or retraining. Source deletion cannot be treated as complete merely because a graph node disappeared. Company strategies and private customer behavior remain organization memory unless separately permitted.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Separate human identity, organization membership, resource grants, model usage authorization and execution capabilities. Use enterprise federation/MFA where required, service workload identities and per-action RBAC/ABAC. Provider OAuth consent is not a general-purpose AI grant. No consumer browser-session copying or hidden API-key fallback. Secrets stay in vault handles and never enter model context or client read-back.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Enforce tenant context in databases, graph/vector queries, objects, caches, queues, logs, backups and support workflows. Support access uses a ticket, just-in-time scope, expiry and audit; sensitive assistance has owner-controlled approval. Untrusted repositories, tools and agent outputs cannot redefine policy. Parse/archive/package risks are isolated before execution.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Controls include supply-chain provenance, secret/advisory/configuration scanning, egress policy, attested worker identity, signed evidence, least-privilege target adapters and independent review. E2EE is a distinct client/local processing mode; server-assisted plaintext computation is not server-blind encryption. Emergency controls live outside candidate code and revoke new claims while reconciling effects already dispatched.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Retain the 47 master-domain definitions as a capability taxonomy. Operational swarms group relevant specialists around tasks and projects; hierarchy need not be permanent. Temporary experts, investigations and incident teams use the same scoped lifecycle, knowledge and budget contracts. Dedicated 3D, business and legal domains require actual tools, versions and domain evaluations before claiming capability.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Swarm messages are typed events, requests, assignments, reviews, arguments, decisions and escalations. They reference artifacts and evidence rather than repeatedly broadcasting all private context. Task responsibility remains singular; collaboration does not create multiple unrestricted writers. Routing honors required skills, current evidence, fairness and provider availability.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Consensus is not truth. Independent role slots, correlation measures and policy vetoes replace raw majority of spawned agents. High-risk unresolved disagreement escalates. Trust is domain-specific and evidence-based; internal credits fund bounded exploration without buying authority. Dynamic reorganization shadows routing, drains leases, preserves memory provenance and verifies that no work loses its accountable owner.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A twin descriptor is required for every connected project, but fidelity is explicit: inventory, executable staging, telemetry-calibrated and continuously reconciled. Pin source, configuration, schema/data fixtures, workloads, dependency contracts, images, cost inputs and calibration revision. Show unsupported questions instead of false numeric results.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Baseline and candidate simulations use the same workload/seed where useful, repeated trials, controlled fault injection and immutable measurement manifests. Production endpoints are not silently reused. Database snapshots require lawful minimization/sanitization or synthetic fixtures. Model CPU/GPU, latency/error/integrity/security and cost separately. Revenue effects require customer evidence and causal experiment design.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Calibration tracks error distribution, drift and validity range. Release decisions require the appropriate real behavior tests even if simulations look favorable. A twin is not a substitute for target read-back or live health. Expensive high-fidelity simulations use budgets and admission. Simulation failure, incomplete coverage and stale telemetry are first-class outcomes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Evolution follows finite cycles: collect authorized observations, curate lessons, propose candidates, sandbox, evaluate independently, approve by policy, canary, measure and promote or roll back. Each interaction may add evidence; improvement is not guaranteed. Genome manifests contain knowledge/reasoning/skill/workflow/decision modules with immutable hashes and acyclic lineage. Credentials/trust/permissions are non-inheritable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Meta-reasoning evaluates concise rationale, evidence and tool traces, not mandatory private chain-of-thought. Prompt/retrieval/workflow updates are separately versioned from provider weights. Qualified skill growth and validated user outcomes matter more than raw agent/node counts. Pause, simplify or retire capabilities when evidence says that is better.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Permanent research swarms maintain approved source universes, freshness, source rights and reproducible dossiers. Prioritize by user need, information gain, urgency, uncertainty and cost. Record primary evidence, vendor claim and inference separately. Publications and popularity do not establish deployability, licensing or superiority.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A dossier includes capability decomposition, standards, implementations/models/datasets, license, hardware, APIs, native alternatives, cost, failure modes, evaluation and architecture placement. Unknown prerequisites remain research tasks. Reproduction occurs in isolated compute with approved materials; proprietary datasets and tools require actual rights.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Research quality is judged by useful verified discoveries and reduced uncertainty. Track contradictory results and negative experiments. A discovery becomes a capability only through typed specification, evaluation and release. Monitor scientific/AI/software/cloud/business changes without granting every newly discovered tool network or production rights.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: - [EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/06-research-invention-and-future-exploration.md](../EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/06-research-invention-and-future-exploration.md)
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The invention pipeline is problem evidence → alternatives/prior-art search → hypothesis → feasibility → prototype → experiment → adoption decision → observed outcome. Preserve authorship, rights, search scope, counterevidence and rejected ideas. Claims of novelty remain conditional; qualified review handles patentability and legal ownership.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A native opportunity is an evidence-linked architecture migration or business experiment that ordinary source completion misses. Proposed additions include a knowledge withdrawal radar, change-impact evidence passport, cross-tool decision reconstruction and quality-adjusted repair economics. These are candidate features, not proven unprecedented inventions. Customer testing must establish whether they outperform simpler alternatives.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: - [EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/06-research-invention-and-future-exploration.md](../EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/06-research-invention-and-future-exploration.md)
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Marketplace modules include agent templates, connectors, parsers/scanners, isolated tools, UI extensions, evaluators and twin models. Every release is immutable, signed and declares digest, permissions, tool schemas, versions, data destinations, licenses, cost and evaluation. Purchasing a pack does not grant production authority.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Publisher onboarding, provenance/SBOM checks, independent domain evaluation, malware/egress testing, installation consent and monitored execution precede trust. Permission-expanding upgrades require fresh authorization. UI extensions are isolated with typed bridges and no ambient session tokens. Emergency revocation blocks future dispatch and identifies affected outputs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Start with curated/private packs before an open marketplace. Review costs and quality incentives must fit unit economics. Detect reciprocal ratings, cloned endorsements and contribution gaming. Financial settlement uses separate tax/payment onboarding, refund/chargeback reserves and immutable ledger. Marketplace effects are a future moat only when trusted supply attracts measurable demand.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Effectful POSTs require idempotency key and normalized payload hash; updates use expected version/If-Match. Accepted work returns an operation handle, not a success claim. Operation states include dispatched, reconciling, succeeded, failed, compensated and canceled. Provider timeouts remain unknown until receipt/read-back establishes outcome.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Schemas declare sizes, pagination/cursors, errors, model/tool capabilities, access scope and deprecation. AgentOS and evolution endpoints use /v1 consistently; prior unprefixed evolution routes are resource shorthand, not a competing public namespace. Event envelopes include event ID, tenant/project/cell, aggregate version, schema version, trace/causation, policy/epoch and artifact pointer. At-least-once delivery requires deduplication and state-machine checks.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: PostgreSQL owns identity/policy, tasks, operations, budgets, evidence metadata, decisions and financial ledger. Composite tenant keys, service identities and enforced row-level policy prevent cross-tenant references. Connection pooling must reset tenant context safely. Neo4j, vectors, lexical search and analytics are derived projections, not alternate financial/task authorities.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Core aggregates include organization/workspace/project, connection/grant, agent/template/genome, task/attempt/run, operation/receipt, artifact/evaluation, finding, memory/assertion/decision, twin/scenario/forecast, plugin/install, reservation/usage/journal and withdrawal. Every mutation has version and provenance; large payloads live in encrypted content-addressed objects.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: No distributed transaction is assumed across PostgreSQL, graph, vectors and external providers. Outbox and reconciliation maintain materialized generations. Migrations use expand/contract, compatibility, checksums and single-writer cutover. Existing D1 generic records are the current implementation, not production PostgreSQL migrations. Complete service schemas are build tasks; reference SQL must be tested on the selected engine before release.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Global navigation groups Command, Projects, Swarms, Intelligence, Operations, Strategy and Administration. The home screen answers what needs attention with prioritized evidence, risks, blockers and recommendations. Progressive disclosure makes novice tasks simple while preserving expert controls and executive views.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Desktop/mobile/CLI/voice share domain states and resumable activity. Graph and swarm views zoom through bounded neighborhoods with accessible tables. Design tokens, components, wireframes and interaction details are retained in the experience appendix. Add disputes/corrections, support access, data export/deletion and cost-liability surfaces. Require keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, zoom, mobile interruption and real backend state testing; visual contrast checks alone do not establish accessibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Executive, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Research, Innovation, Project Visualization, Realtime Swarm, Operations and Cost dashboards share evidence envelopes. Every metric carries scope, observation time, source/version, coverage, confidence and methodology. Unknown does not become zero or green.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Add an execution truth panel showing proposed agents versus actually dispatched turns, pending receipts, unresolved cost, excluded files/languages and failed parsers. Add release lineage and active-policy view. Executive modes keep operational proof accessible without displaying sensitive source by default. Mobile prioritizes alert review, pause and status; complex diff/graph editing moves to capable surfaces with preserved context.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Retain ten gated phases: MVP, Beta, Launch, Growth, Scale, Enterprise, Platform, Ecosystem, Market Leader and Digital Civilization. Calendar estimates are subordinate to evidence gates and funding. Scope is not deleted because it ships later.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: MVP proves one authorized repository-to-validated-change workflow. Beta adds durable collaboration/memory/search and bounded automation. Launch adds paid team accounts, verified billing and curated integrations. Growth improves retention and operational quality before broad acquisition. Scale introduces tested cells. Enterprise introduces sold identity/residency/DR contracts. Platform/marketplace require reliable contracts and quality supply. Market leadership and civilization are strategic states to earn, not scheduled guarantees.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Year 1 focuses customer value and trustworthy delivery; Year 2 broadens operational intelligence; Year 3 grows enterprise/cells; Year 5 evaluates ecosystem and calibrated twins; Year 10 preserves optionality across models, devices and organizational workflows. Version numbers and years are separate axes. Every roadmap feature maps to a backlog ID, owner role, prerequisite and measurable exit.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Minimum flow: supported account authorization → immutable snapshot → language-aware map/coverage → evidence-linked findings → scoped objective/plan/budget → isolated candidate → independent behavior/security validation → human review → draft PR receipt/read-back → persistent decision/outcome memory. Do not require all 47 swarms, every integration or the entire target database fleet on day one.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: MVP release gates: real provider/resource grants; actual isolated worker; exact evidence binding; concurrent admission/idempotency; no critical secret/access flaw; interruption/revocation paths; restore/export; truthful UX; representative supported-language benchmark and customer-observed value. The prior 16–24-week and staffing/cash assumptions remain estimates until these gates and actual team availability are measured. A paid pilot is preferable to a premature public promise.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: - [UNFINISHED-WORK/implementation-order.md](../UNFINISHED-WORK/implementation-order.md)
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Operate billing/subscription entitlement, root spend reservation, customer support, incident escalation, backup restoration, deletion, usage reconciliation and consent/account switching. Add engineering/security/project dashboards with accessible critical journeys. Integrate one or two high-value sources proven in customer workflows.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Release requires matched task outcomes, independent application tests, real repository read-back and measured operational envelopes. Standard plans expose explicit quotas and unavailable capabilities. Production deploy remains opt-in to a supported target and policy; draft PR mode is the safe default until target outcome evidence passes. V1 can be sold only after support and operating ownership are real.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: V2 adds repository-native agent collaboration, richer memory/reasoning, multiple supported integrations and telemetry-backed operations. Support child tasks with shared budgets, role-assigned review and persistent disagreement. Expand parsing/data-flow/API mapping through versioned capability envelopes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: V2 release gates include cross-tenant retrieval/cache tests, source withdrawal convergence, stale report rejection, orchestration crash/replay, budget conservation and post-change fault validation. No automatic promotion of model confidence into production authority. Validate whether additional collaboration improves outcomes enough to justify token/review cost.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: V5 targets a tested multi-cell enterprise ecosystem with dedicated modes, calibrated twins, evaluated specialist packs, reliable marketplace and cross-domain project intelligence. Version 5 is not necessarily year 5; release timing depends on prior gates and demand.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Operational gates: single-writer migration/failover, restore with tombstones, cell hot-spot admission, financial settlement, publisher revocation, evaluator poisoning containment and forecast backtests. Cross-cloud support must be proven per chosen combination. Revenue simulations remain scenario-based unless customer experiments validate them. A marketplace or civilization visualization cannot substitute for core task quality.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: - [EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/09-contracts-scaling-and-implementation.md](../EVOLUTION-ARCHITECTURE/09-contracts-scaling-and-implementation.md)
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: V10 is a long-term adaptive platform with replaceable model/tool/runtime providers, durable decision memory, privacy-safe learning, broad evaluated domain coverage and self-reorganizing coordination under human-governed Omega policy. It supports rich simulations and strategic foresight without presenting distant futures as facts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The platform can create new experts from detected capability gaps, but each gains operational eligibility through research, tests, grants and budgets. Collective discoveries transfer by provenance and rights; failed patterns withdraw. Agent economics reward verified contribution and diversity without granting constitutional control.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Readiness requires decades-oriented compatibility, cryptographic agility, export, model/data withdrawal, succession, accountable appeals and sustainable unit economics. No claim of AGI, consciousness, inevitability or competitor-proof dominance is needed. The V10 test is whether increasingly broad authorized work remains understandable, reliable, affordable and controllable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Funding follows demonstrated risk reduction: bootstrap a narrow prototype, finance customer pilots, seek angel/seed funding on validated value and operating evidence, then raise growth capital for repeatable acquisition and enterprise demand. Series labels are financing options, not mandatory milestones. Independence remains viable only if revenue and cash discipline support it.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use explicit runway and staffing assumptions, founder contribution, loaded compensation, cloud/model/worker costs, acquisition budget, support obligations and reserve. The financial scenario model is illustrative; target-derived acquisition is not an independently forecast demand engine. Freeze a prior forecast before correction and compare new versions.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Start with observed workload distributions. Capacity targets from the production package are planning envelopes, not achieved performance or machine orders. Benchmark hot monorepos, ACL-heavy queries, multimodal assets, provider limits, long tasks and uneven tenant demand. Millions of inactive agent manifests do not require millions of live containers.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Validate latency tails, queue age, error rates, cost and restore at realistic load. Add cells before headroom disappears, not after a universal repository count threshold. Region and provider failures require tested degraded operation. Root budget allocations crossing cells use debit-before-credit with reconciliation; a partition cannot create new capacity or spend.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Recommended pricing remains a hypothesis: workspace subscription plus explicit bounded usage, enterprise commitments/dedicated charges and later curated marketplace fees. Agent count is a weak primary meter because logical specialists may be cheap or redundant. Charge for understandable value and costly resources without hiding retries or uncertain receipts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Consumption revenue must map to incremental paid workload and corresponding model/worker/support costs. Included jobs, overage jobs, successful tasks and failed/retried tasks are separate quantities. Customer-paid eligible model plans are not silently rebilled as provider API consumption. Gross margin must include attributable infrastructure/support and free-tier cost.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Measure contribution per retained workspace and validated outcome, CAC/payback, churn, expansion, support burden, concentration and cash collection. Stop unprofitable research/automation loops through reservations and value evaluation. Do not reduce safety checks to improve margin. Enterprise pricing must cover delivery/security/DR/support commitments; marketplace revenue must net refunds, publisher payouts and review costs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The v2 model now derives incremental overage workload from an explicit illustrative USD 1.50 per equivalent job and charges model/runtime cost on included plus overage jobs. This is an internal planning assumption, not a provider quote or accepted customer price. Base additional funding to the stated cash reserve rises to USD 5,290,966; Downside USD 7,488,533; Upside USD 4,026,014. ARR stays unchanged because consumption is excluded from recurring subscription ARR. Base annual operating cash becomes positive in year 5 rather than year 4. Original v1 inputs/results are retained as superseded history in the strategy package. Demand targets, collection timing and sales capacity still need independent validation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Competitors can copy ideas and many interfaces. Fractal names, dashboards and a knowledge graph alone are not a defensible moat. Defensibility must be earned through customer-authorized longitudinal decision/outcome data, useful context reconstruction, dependable change evidence, trusted operational integration and measurable quality/cost advantages.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Data/knowledge moats require rights and actual coverage; learning effects require demonstrated generalization without privacy leakage. Agent effects require validated specialization, not raw population. Marketplace/network effects need active quality suppliers and customers; enterprise effects arise from proven governance and workflow adoption. Research effects need reproducible novel capabilities. Civilization effects are coordination hypotheses to test.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Customer export and interoperability should remain strong; lock-in through withheld data is not the strategy. Benchmark against existing coding workflows, including repository-native agents. Potential native differentiators include an evidence passport per change, decision-to-defect reconstruction and withdrawal-aware learning. Validate willingness to pay and switching value before declaring uniqueness.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Maintain a risk register with owner, cause, likelihood/uncertainty, impact, affected scope, mitigations, detection, residual risk and review date. Highest current delivery risks are live authorization availability, actual worker isolation, unsupported languages/tasks, absent production telemetry, financial reservation concurrency and customer-value evidence.

occurrences.statement: Twenty billion edges at a planning assumption of 160 bytes per logical edge imply 3.2 TB before indexes, database overhead and replication. Budget 3–8 times that logical size for the first sizing experiment: 9.6–25.6 TB per complete logical copy, then account separately for replica and backup policies. Five billion nodes at 400 bytes imply 2 TB before overhead. Measure actual Neo4j store/index characteristics on the chosen schema; do not order machines from these estimates.

occurrences.statement: Ten billion vectors at 1,536 float32 dimensions imply 61.44 TB of raw dense vector values. An exploratory 8-bit representation implies 15.36 TB of vector values before indexes/payload/replication; accuracy must pass retrieval evaluation before selecting quantization. Tier active content, deduplicate within authorization scope, and price embedding refresh explicitly.

occurrences.statement: At 1 KB/event, 100,000 events/second produces 8.64 TB/day of uncompressed business envelopes. Seven-day hot retention is 60.48 TB logical; three replicas are 181.44 TB before compression and broker overhead. Use an object archive and shorter topic-specific retention where justified. Telemetry is a separate pipeline and must not multiply this journal with per-token events.

occurrences.statement: ## Dependency discipline
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A command request should synchronously cross at most gateway → owning service → policy/reservation, then commit and return an operation handle. Long inference, extraction, graph rebuild, rendering and scanning are asynchronous. Read composition uses bounded BFF fanout with deadlines and degraded per-panel states; never synchronously join every store.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Identity, policy, financial reservation and operation intent are required for sensitive writes. Graph, vector, scores and analytics can be unavailable without taking down the core task journal. If policy authority is unavailable, new privileged actions stop; running read-only jobs may use unexpired bounded capabilities where permitted. If billing reservation authority is unavailable, no new billable dispatch occurs; workers checkpoint existing reserved work.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Identity/policy/vault and financial ledger require dedicated review ownership. Execution services own sandbox breakouts and job correctness. Intelligence services own provenance, coverage, retrieval leakage and graph freshness. Experience services own accessibility and consent UX. Platform SRE owns cell capacity, routing epochs, backups and recovery. Security signs releases with material permission/isolation changes. Billing owns reconciliation and corrections, never silently rewrites historical usage.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: An incident has one operational commander, an evidence timeline and an explicit severity. Emergency agent creation does not grant break-glass rights; those require independently logged human authorization with scope and expiry.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Each agent is a logical principal, not a process. Identity is `{tenant_id, agent_id, template_digest, parent_agent_id, root_run_id, authority_epoch}`. Additional fields: specialization, goal/objectives, immutable context snapshot, task queue reference, working-memory handle, scoped long-term memory selectors, communication subscriptions, tool grants, model policy, cost reservation, deadline, evaluation rubric, health state and retirement policy.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A swarm is a scoped collaboration aggregate with members, parent swarm, objective, project graph snapshot, policy, supervisor and budget. Root departments include Security, Backend, Frontend, DevOps, Cloud, Database, Architecture, Testing, Documentation, Research, AI, 3D, Game Development, Business Intelligence, Revenue, Innovation and Future Prediction. The 47 detailed domains from the existing catalog specialize these departments. All share the same security/task protocol; domain prompts and tools are versioned separately.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: No fixed schema depth constrains parent/child hierarchy. Execution still requires available budget and a spawn grant. Depth-sensitive operations use iterative traversal/path indexes, not application stack recursion. Huge subtrees are paginated. Per-root cumulative limits survive spawn/retry; splitting into new agents cannot reset quotas. Long-running improvement loops start new workflow generations with parent lineage and retained budget policy.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A suspended agent has no active compute lease. A retired identity remains in the evidence ledger, with credentials revoked and memory retention governed by policy. Health distinguishes no work, waiting approval, waiting provider, unavailable worker, stalled lease, failed execution and unhealthy evaluation. Agent creation is idempotent by `{root_run, parent_task, specialization, generation}`.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The runtime uses a lease with monotonic fencing token plus heartbeats. Control state is durable; Redis presence expires and cannot establish completion. An execution result must match task ID, attempt, lease/fencing token, input digest, output digest and attested execution identity. Late results become evidence-only or are rejected, never applied to a newer revision.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 3. Generate a typed proposal DAG: inputs, tasks, dependencies, specialist roles, artifact contracts, estimates and acceptance tests.

occurrences.statement: ## Durable workflow implementation
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Official behavior basis: [workflow determinism](https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-definition) and [child workflows](https://docs.temporal.io/child-workflows). Product-specific retry, fairness and approval policy are design choices in this package.

occurrences.statement: Provider account sign-in supplies only the capabilities granted by that provider. A cloud workforce identity is not a model usage grant. An agent cannot invent a new integration to bypass a missing provider authorization.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: All private records include tenant, project/resource scope, classification, residency, source version and provenance. Independent stores maintain a projection watermark. A query can return stale-but-labeled data for permitted read use; release decisions require a matching approved source and evidence watermark. Store failure never authorizes a broader fallback search.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Canonical node fields: `entity_id`, `tenant_id`, `project_id`, `kind`, `source_system`, `external_id`, `source_revision`, `content_digest`, `valid_from`, `valid_to`, `observed_at`, `classification`, `acl_version`, `extractor_version`, `confidence`, `artifact_ref` and small query properties. IDs are stable within tenant/source; paths/names are attributes, not global identities. Function identity accounts for language-qualified signature and file lineage. A rename creates a lineage relation rather than claiming unchanged identity without evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Evidence establishes connectivity. An unresolved import/unknown service is a typed unresolved node, not an invented confirmed relationship. A project may contain isolated entities until discovery proves connections; “everything connected” is an integration objective, not permission to fabricate edges.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Neo4j composite/federated facilities may assist in-region composition where the chosen edition and deployment support them. Enterprise and hosted availability must be verified before procurement; the architecture also supports application-level federation. [Neo4j composite concepts](https://neo4j.com/docs/operations-manual/current/scalability/composite-databases/concepts/).
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Public API accepts typed graph-query operations, never arbitrary untrusted Cypher. Default traversal: depth ≤4, node limit 1,000, edge limit 5,000, 2-second execution deadline; privileged analytical jobs receive separate resource reservations. Pagination uses snapshot/partition cursors. Algorithms such as dependency-centrality run asynchronously on scoped projections, not on interactive query threads. Cross-cell queries return partial coverage explicitly when a permitted shard is unavailable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Ingestion writes extraction batches identified by `{source revision, extractor digest}`. The graph writer deduplicates by operation ID, applies a versioned batch, marks projection watermark and emits completion. Deleted source produces tombstones; authorized rebuild replays the journal into a new projection and swaps the directory only after validation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Innovation | Opportunities, novelty research, experiments and outcomes | Versioned hypothesis/validation state |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.
