occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A memory assertion is `{claim, type=fact|hypothesis|decision|observation, evidence_refs, scope, confidence, valid_time, owner, revision}`. Model summaries retain citations and may not replace the original evidence. Contradictions create linked assertions and review tasks. Retrieval marks stale, disputed, superseded and source-deleted facts. “Indefinite memory” means durable preservation when lawful and contracted; user deletion, legal retention and encryption-key revocation still apply.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Human authentication supports enterprise OIDC and SAML federation, passkeys/MFA and managed workforce provisioning through SCIM. Customer organization linking requires verified membership, not matching email domains alone. Desktop/mobile use authorization-code flow with PKCE in the system browser and protected OS credential storage. CLI supports browser or provider-supported device authorization. Browser sessions use HttpOnly, Secure cookies, origin/CSRF checks, short access lifetimes and server-side revocation. Workspaces never receive provider passwords.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The current Sites sign-in remains the owner-private prototype entry point. Production Identity Service maps it into an organization/session model only through a documented trusted assertion. GitHub authorization is a separate connection. ChatGPT/model account authorization is another separate grant; identity login alone does not authorize inference. Supported hosted plan usage requires the provider-approved integration. Google login can identify a person or authorize particular Google resources; it grants no blanket access to every AI provider.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: RBAC establishes organizational roles: owner, administrator, security administrator, billing administrator, engineer, reviewer, researcher, auditor and viewer. Agent/service principals have no default human role. ABAC evaluates tenant/project membership, environment tier, action class, resource labels, source classification, device assurance, region, approval, time window, cost and incident context. Explicit deny wins; membership alone cannot authorize production deployment.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Sandbox | Build/test/scan in isolated replica | Approved image/tool class, compute/cost reservation, artifact policy |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Production change | Deployment, data migration, containment | Current authorization, approval policy, maintenance/blast-radius limits and fresh health evidence |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A capability is signed, audience-bound and references `{tenant, principal, project, action, targets, input_digest, authority_epoch, policy_version, grant_epoch, reservation_id, expires_at, nonce}`. Tool broker verifies it immediately before dispatch. Delegation intersects parent grant and template policy; no child can increase privilege. Production approvals bind exact artifact digest, target, plan, source revision and expiry. Any material change invalidates approval. Separation of duties prevents proposer from being its only required approver.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Tenant context is derived from authenticated membership and route ownership. Browser-supplied tenant IDs are selectors to validate, not authority. PostgreSQL service roles have no BYPASSRLS and do not own tables; enable and FORCE row security. RLS adds defense in depth, while service-level project/action checks remain mandatory. A transaction-local tenant context is set by trusted middleware and reset by pool boundaries; leaked pooled context is a test case. [PostgreSQL row security](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-rowsecurity.html).
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Neo4j, Qdrant, object storage, Redis keys, message topics and metrics queries all require server-owned tenant/project scoping. Dedicated cells offer stronger physical isolation but still need authorization. Download URLs are short-lived, bound to current classification and permission where feasible, and never authorize listing another prefix. Egress checks cover redirects, DNS rebinding and cloud metadata endpoints. Resource counts, search suggestions and graph neighborhoods must not disclose forbidden entities.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A sandbox receives immutable sanitized input objects and a narrow artifact upload capability. Repository write and production credentials stay outside it in the tool broker. Dependency network access uses an approved package mirror/proxy with digest records, never unrestricted internet. GPU/render/licensed runtimes have separate pools with license accounting and device-isolation tests. Artifact scanning and provenance verification happen before another tenant or a release consumes output.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Signed builds, SBOMs, verified source/image digests, dependency advisories, publisher identity and restricted build workers protect the supply chain. Threat detection covers token misuse, unusual extraction volumes, cross-tenant requests, suspicious model/tool instructions, sandbox network escapes and financial abuse. Support access uses time-bound reasoned grants and customer-visible audit, with no unrestricted plaintext access in E2EE mode.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Compliance is a control/evidence program with mapped scope, retention, residency, incident response and independent review. The design supports applicable standards; it does not certify them. Authorized penetration testing uses explicit target scope, safe test windows and data handling; a security agent cannot discover and attack arbitrary external systems.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Required fields: `event_id`, `type`, `schema_version`, `tenant_id`, `project_id`, `aggregate_id`, `aggregate_version`, `authority_epoch`, `occurred_at`, `recorded_at`, `producer`, `actor`, `correlation_id`, `causation_id`, `classification`, `residency`, `payload_ref` or bounded `payload`, and `trace_context`. Envelopes must contain no access tokens, credentials or raw sensitive source. A supplied tenant context is authenticated against producer scope; messages are never trusted merely because they are on a bus.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Default payload limit 64 KB; large content is in immutable objects with hash and authorized retrieval. Schema compatibility is checked in CI. Additive optional fields are allowed within a version; semantic changes create a new type/version and dual-read migration. Consumers reject unsupported schemas into quarantine rather than guessing meanings.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Owning service commits aggregate revision and outbox row in one PostgreSQL transaction. Outbox publisher may emit twice. Consumer records `{consumer, event_id}` and its local mutation in the same transaction, then acknowledges. Aggregate version and authority epoch detect stale/out-of-order effects. Consumers buffer bounded gaps or request replay; they do not invent missing predecessor state.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Dead-letter/quarantine records preserve event ID, sanitized failure, consumer version and retry state. Replay requires an authorized operator, dry-run scope and idempotency safeguards; replay of observational events cannot automatically replay production side effects. Business events retain 7-day hot journal by default, with archive and topic-specific contracts; financial/audit retention is separately governed. Retention is not a substitute for backups.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Workflow nodes have states `pending`, `ready`, `admitted`, `running`, `waiting_input`, `waiting_approval`, `reconciling`, `completed`, `failed`, `canceled`, `compensating`. Root cancellation stops new dispatch, signals descendants, revokes grants, records dispatched operations and performs policy-approved compensation. Successful repository/production writes cannot be canceled by deleting the job record.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Parent completion policy declares required children, optional research and tolerated failures. Compensation is explicit: delete an unused branch only if owned and unchanged; roll back deployment only to a verified compatible version; database reversal is not assumed possible. New workflow generations carry lineage and remaining long-term quota. Continue-As-New/checkpoint policies prevent unbounded histories while preserving searchable events/artifacts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Candidate delivery | `/v1/change-sets`, `/{id}/validate`, `/review`, `/pull-requests` |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Paths abbreviated in this table inherit their parent scope; the owning service resolves all resource ownership. The reference OpenAPI contract covers core task/change/deployment commands; the resource catalog is the complete family boundary and must become service-specific specifications during implementation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Authenticated principal must be a permitted organization/workspace member. Requests include `Idempotency-Key` for effectful POSTs, `If-Match` for updates and an optional request/correlation ID. The server derives tenant/project context. Body max is endpoint-specific: ordinary command 64 KB; snapshots/assets use reserved multipart object uploads, never unlimited API bodies.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A change-set submission binds parent run, base commit/snapshot digest, patch/asset manifest and evidence refs. Repository or deployment command references an approved immutable change-set; it cannot replace it with new code in the same request. Deployment additionally binds environment/target, plan digest, rollback artifact, health gate and grant/approval.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: `GET /operations/{id}` returns `accepted|dispatched|reconciling|succeeded|failed|compensated|canceled`, provider receipt, output artifact and observed outcome. An uncertain side effect remains reconciling until a provider-side read establishes state. Idempotency scope includes tenant, principal/action, target and normalized payload hash; reusing a key with different input returns conflict. Retention is at least the operation reconciliation horizon; release/financial effects retain durable identities beyond ephemeral HTTP cache expiry.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: List APIs use opaque signed cursor, stable snapshot/watermark and bounded `limit` (default 50, max 200). Do not paginate by mutable offsets for huge changing sets. Responses include source revision, observation time, projection watermark, coverage, classification and `partial` with source-level errors. Strong read-after-write selects the owning authority or waits for a specified watermark until deadline; timeouts return pending state, not stale success.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Streaming uses event IDs and typed terminal events. A model stream has `delta`, `usage`, `completed`, `failed` or `incomplete`; only completed establishes success. A task stream has committed state transitions separate from token text. Partial provider output cannot become validated candidate code without a completed result and schema/behavior checks.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Enforce per-identity/org/project/provider rate, concurrency and resource-weight budgets. Global traffic spikes can degrade research while preserving admission/status and incidents. SDKs retry only declared retryable reads/idempotent commands with jitter and deadlines; never blindly retry a side effect after an unknown outcome. Browser CORS is explicit; CSRF checks apply to cookie mutations. Uploads verify digest, media type, malware and compressed expansion limits before processing.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Client compatibility policy: support the current major and previous major through a declared deprecation window; versions are pinned in plugin/template manifests. Breaking permission or artifact semantics require a new contract version. Generated client/schema conformance tests and service consumer tests gate releases. Public API documentation includes limits, consistency, residency, usage cost and actual capability availability.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: Universal integration, repository intelligence and missing-things engine
occurrences.statement: # Universal integration, repository intelligence and missing-things engine
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ## Required integration families
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 3D/content | Blender, Maya, Cinema4D, Unity, Unreal | Versioned scene/asset bridge, licensed runtime, GPU/renderer pools and artifact validation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Dedicated implementable inventories and acceptance criteria remain in `../UNFINISHED-WORK/04-integration-inventory.md`. Support is versioned and capability-specific. Unsupported discontinued provider paths are replaced by documented exports/bridges, not fabricated endpoints.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 1. Authorize selected resources and verify branch/commit scope. Pin immutable base commit and connection grant revision.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 2. Receive validated webhook or polling delta; deduplicate provider event ID and verify signature/replay window. Queue a source-snapshot workflow.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 4. Store tenant-encrypted immutable source objects. Scan/redact secrets according to tenant policy; retain restricted original only where explicitly permitted. Parsed evidence must not leak secret values.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 6. Persist extraction manifests, incremental graph/vector updates, scanner evidence and coverage watermark. Failed extractors produce incomplete coverage rather than “nothing missing.”
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 8. Watch further commits and operational signals, invalidating affected entities/chunks/findings with dependency-aware scheduling.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Code mapping includes language, file/symbol identity, signature/location and parser coverage. Dependency mapping includes resolved package versions, source provenance, transitive graph and SBOM. Data-flow mapping records source/sink edges, validation and confidence; dynamic cases remain unknown until traces or tests establish them. Architecture mapping identifies boundaries and deployment evidence, not just directories. API mapping includes auth/schema/version and compatibility. Feature mapping links requirements, tests, user flows and behavior with evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ## Continuous missing-things detector
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Rules are versioned expectations with applicability predicates, required evidence, failure condition, severity/confidence, suggested remediation and counterexamples. An expectation can derive from project requirements, environment policy, language/framework, user journey, architecture and business objective. Rules cover missing tests, validation, security controls, logging, API/pages/features/business logic, integrations/docs/optimization, revenue paths, product/market opportunities and competitive advantages.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Technical gaps should be evidence-based: “No recovery test for this declared critical payment flow in the analyzed scope,” rather than “the company has no tests” after a partial import. Business opportunities are hypothesis findings with market/customer evidence and experiment plans. A missing monetization path is not automatically a defect.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Finding identity includes tenant, subject entity/revision, rule version and evidence fingerprint. Disposition states are `open`, `investigating`, `accepted_risk`, `candidate_ready`, `fixed_unverified`, `verified_fixed`, `superseded`. A manual resolved click does not verify a repair. A change-based re-evaluation updates the current finding while preserving historical state/evidence. Severity can override prioritization but cannot authorize remediation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Repository intelligence output contains coverage, freshness, architecture/dependency maps, threat/debt findings, score confidence, roadmap alternatives and prioritized action backlog. Subscribe to source/configuration/advisory changes and schedule bounded rescans; stop when consent is revoked. Improvement proposals feed the autonomous cycle, not an unconditional deployment loop.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reference deployment supports AWS, Azure and Google Cloud through a portable Kubernetes/service contract. Cloud adapters provide identity, private networking, load balancing, KMS, object storage, managed PostgreSQL where suitable, DNS and observability export. Vercel is not required. Managed services may differ across providers; preserve API/consistency/backup contracts instead of pretending every cloud service is interchangeable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use reviewed infrastructure-as-code modules, provider lockfiles, encrypted state and workload federation. Separate bootstrapping/migration identities from application identities. Infrastructure changes produce a plan, target/resource selector, policy checks, approval and rollback/recovery plan. Protect DNS, routing, keys and tenant-directory changes as high-impact operations.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Build once, sign artifact and SBOM, then promote the same digest through development, integration, staging, canary and production. Cells deploy in rings: internal → small reference cell → low-risk tenants → regional expansion → global rollout. GitOps reconciliation applies reviewed manifests; it cannot override a denied policy or deploy mutable image tags. Service mesh/network policies deny unnecessary east-west and egress access.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Application canaries evaluate error rate, latency, saturation, queue lag, permission failures and business-operation correctness. Database changes use expand → dual read/write where necessary → backfill → verified cutover → contract. Rollback compatibility includes data/schema and event/template versions; a container rollback alone is insufficient. Temporal workflow versions must replay existing histories correctly; retain compatible workers until old runs drain or migrate.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: One project aggregate has one active home writer. PostgreSQL zone failover uses synchronous durability and a tested election/fencing configuration. Cross-region standard tier is asynchronous with explicitly declared RPO. Zero-RPO enterprise configurations require synchronous cross-region acknowledgement and measured latency/availability tradeoffs; no async replication is advertised as zero data loss.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 2. Establish that old writers cannot dispatch: revoke/fence routing epoch, tool grants and execution authority. If old region cannot be fenced, privileged writes remain paused.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 6. Verify targets, reservations and financial receipts before retrying work. Update directory and publish incident evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Source artifacts and journals replicate only to permitted residency destinations. Cross-cloud disaster recovery uses portable manifests and encrypted object replication with independently verified restore capability, not an assumed universal live database replication feature. Regional analytics may produce only approved non-sensitive aggregates outside residency boundaries.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Recovery tests include missing keys, corrupted backup, partial event archive, incompatible parser/model generation, revoked source access and restoring a deleted tenant. Tombstone/deletion ledgers replay before restored data becomes queryable. Restoring a backup must not resurrect a revoked permission or replay an already completed financial/production operation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The durable cycle is `observe → understand → analyze → plan → build → validate → approve/authorize → deploy → monitor → learn → repeat`. Requirements include the user's requested autonomous loop; validation/authorization are mandatory states rather than optional prose. Observation can trigger proposals automatically. Production action requires a configured policy and authorized target.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Triggers: repository/configuration change, security advisory, SLO incident, scheduled debt review, product requirement, customer feedback or validated opportunity. Deduplicate trigger/source revision and attach coverage/freshness. Rank by safety/impact, urgency, dependencies, effort, cost and confidence. Reserved incident capacity prevents research scans from starving outages.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Input: objective, target project/environment, immutable base source, scoped grants, budget, definition of done and change risk. Plan decomposes architecture/implementation/test/docs/migration tasks. Agents retrieve scoped context and propose bounded artifacts. Compile/build/lint/scanners and behavioral tests run against immutable candidate in isolation. Independent specialists review safety and correctness with typed approvals/dissent.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Changes support additions, edits, moves/deletes, binaries/assets and generated infrastructure through explicit manifest types. A patch binds original path/blob and resulting digest. File containment, archive expansion, secret handling and artifact provenance are deterministic checks. Model output cannot request arbitrary host shell execution. Dependencies/commands are discovered and allowed by project policy and controlled images, with approved egress to package mirrors.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Delivery produces branch/PR or reviewed staging deployment. Base revision must still match target; otherwise rebase/regenerate with new evidence and approvals. CI/test evidence binds the exact commit/artifact, tool image and environment. A successful previous run is not reusable for changed code unless declared cache keys cover all relevant inputs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Incident record: target/project, first/last observation, severity, SLO impact, timeline, telemetry coverage, recent deployments, graph context, suspected causes, commander and repair budget. Diagnose competing causes using evidence rather than a single model guess. Read-only investigation agents can spawn under incident scope; emergency privilege remains separately authorized.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Repair plan includes fault hypothesis, scope, intended effect, alternatives, preconditions, measurable success, blast radius, dry-run/twin evidence and compensation. Allowed automatic actions are narrow classes configured per target (for example restart a stateless unhealthy replica under existing rollout policy). Schema deletion, irreversible data changes, IAM expansion and major production migrations require stronger review. An agent cannot widen its own automatic-action policy.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: For database changes, define forward recovery and backup/checkpoint; rollback may be unsafe after new data is written. The platform must represent “irreversible” and require the configured human decision. Never promise generic rollback for every migration.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Classify outcome as validated repair, symptom relief, regression, inconclusive or failed repair. Store evidence, diagnosis accuracy, elapsed time, user impact, cost, rollback and lessons. Promote reusable playbooks only after representative controlled experiments; do not train/publish private incident content across tenants without permission.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Recurring improvement runs retain objective/budget/stop conditions and produce new versioned proposals. Prevent oscillation with cooldown, repeated-fault correlation and bounded retries. Global/tenant/project kill switches revoke future dispatch and signal descendants. Runbooks handle unknown provider outcome, missing telemetry, sandbox compromise, cost ceiling and conflicting repairs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Gate | Required evidence |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Behavior | Relevant isolated unit/integration/critical-flow tests; coverage statement |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Review | Required independent roles, no unresolved policy veto, approval bound to digest |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Tests that merely prove files exist are useful integrity checks but cannot satisfy behavioral correctness or production healing. The current implementation has snapshot repairs; this target architecture adds real incident, target and outcome systems without claiming they are already deployed.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: Digital twins, future prediction, innovation and competitive intelligence
occurrences.statement: # Digital twins, future prediction, innovation and competitive intelligence
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Every connected project receives a twin descriptor, even when its evidence is incomplete. Descriptor includes source commit, infrastructure/configuration inventory version, sanitized database snapshot or synthetic data generation, workload/traffic model, business-process model, cost inputs, dependency contracts, environment image digests, permission boundary and calibration dataset. Do not label a descriptor a real-time replica before live telemetry and representative environment coverage exist.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Twin levels: inventory twin → executable staging twin → telemetry-calibrated twin → continuously reconciled project twin. Each declares supported questions and excluded dimensions. A code simulator, queueing model and customer revenue forecast have different validation requirements. External systems use mocks, recorded contracts or explicitly authorized staging endpoints, never unapproved production side effects.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Scenario binds baseline twin revision, proposed change, workload distribution, fault injection, random seed, resource budget and measurement plan. Replicate code, servers, databases, traffic, infrastructure and business-process interactions at the highest validated fidelity affordable for the question. Execute build/runtime/load/security/failure tests in dedicated sandbox pools. Isolate credentials and prohibit destructive calls to production.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Results include latency distributions, throughput, CPU/GPU/memory/storage, error/data-integrity measures, vulnerability/control deltas, cloud cost and business-process outcomes. Compare baseline and candidate under repeated representative workloads; report confidence intervals and sensitivity to inputs. A scenario may return unsupported/insufficient calibration instead of a numeric answer.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Calibration compares predictions against authorized staging/production observations over time. Store model version, error distribution, drift and validity range. Revenue predictions require actual product/customer/financial evidence and causal experiment assumptions; traffic alone cannot predict sales. Cost calculations use approved rate cards, observed resource quantities and model/provider usage.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ## Future engine
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Produce Year 1, 3, 5 and 10 project scenarios plus V2/V3/V5/V10 product evolution views. Horizons are alternative conditional paths, not inevitable predictions. Inputs: present architecture/health, customer requirements, dependency lifecycle, industry/source research, workload growth, budget and staffing assumptions. Outputs: technical/business risks, growth opportunities, architecture options, migrations, scaling milestones, costs, dependencies, indicators and reversible experiments.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Each forecast stores `{horizon, assumptions, evidence_cutoff, scenario, probability_interval_if_calibrated, confidence, milestones, leading_indicators, validation_plan, superseded_by}`. When probabilities are not calibrated, use explicitly qualitative likelihood; never invent percentages. Trigger reevaluation on source changes, market evidence, realized milestones or forecast drift. Evaluate prior forecasts and preserve failed assumptions.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Architecture evolution uses real bottleneck/scale evidence and migration compatibility. A longer horizon reduces certainty and increases scenario breadth. A future plan references required implementation tasks and budgets rather than merely inventing new service names.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Observe problems/opportunities → research alternatives → formulate hypothesis → novelty/feasibility/demand assessment → prototype → experiment → measured outcome → roadmap decision. Search products/features/automations/markets/business models/technology shifts with cited current evidence and query scope. “Unbuilt” or “undiscovered” remains a hypothesis when search coverage is incomplete.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Opportunity record contains affected customer/problem, proposed value, competing alternatives, technical feasibility, architecture/safety constraints, cost model, demand evidence, experiment metric, confidence and owner. Patent potential requires qualified novelty/legal review; the platform does not certify patentability. Innovation memory keeps negative experiments and rejected ideas to avoid repeated reinvention.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reports include opportunity ranking, evidence freshness, alternative explanations, validation budget, customer research plan and explicit go/no-go criteria. Autonomous prototyping can build isolated artifacts under existing grants; launching a business/product or sending messages requires its own authorized action.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Approved public and licensed sources feed source-aware competitor/product/framework/open-source/technology/business-model records. Record publish/observed dates, methodology, source rights and uncertainty. Keep acquired private competitor data out unless lawfully authorized. Market narratives are not evidence of a product's actual capabilities.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Recommend strategic responses linked to the organization's objectives and differentiated constraints: adopt, partner, integrate, build, migrate, experiment or monitor. Each recommendation contains alternatives, switching cost, dependency risk, expected measurable benefit and invalidation triggers. Track framework adoption with an explicitly defined sample; stars, downloads, mentions and revenue are different measures.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Research agents read approved sources and produce attributed evidence bundles. Analyst agents derive hypotheses. Product/architecture reviewers assess fit. Financial/privacy/security reviewers gate experiments. Executive scorecards show both opportunity and confidence/validation status. Global intelligence shares only public or explicitly approved aggregates; private company strategy remains company memory.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Web uses a typed React application with server-composed authorized view models, accessible components and virtualized large data surfaces. Preserve the current Sites console as the migration entry point; split BFF/backend contracts without rewriting working experiences unnecessarily. Desktop uses a signed native shell with local project bridge, OS credential storage, system-browser authorization and user-visible directory/device permissions. Mobile is a native/appropriate cross-platform client for monitoring, review, approvals and scoped incident control, with secure device sessions and push preferences. CLI provides scriptable commands, JSON output, resumable logs and provider-supported browser/device sign-in. Voice translates authorized intent into proposed commands; consequential actions require explicit confirmation of target and artifact through the configured policy, and voice alone is not high-assurance identity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Shared design system defines navigation, type/color/spacing, status/evidence semantics, charts, graph views, diff, artifacts, forms, approvals and error recovery. SDK/model contracts are shared; platform-specific interaction and accessibility remain first-class. Client offline mode permits cached authorized read views with freshness labels and encrypted local storage; it cannot queue production approvals indefinitely or manufacture new capabilities. On reconnect, revalidate identity, grants and source revisions before replaying any permitted command.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Command console separates objective entry, plan/dependency view, running activity, evidence, candidate review and external action. Use a command palette for navigation/read actions; production changes open a target/evidence/approval surface. Show agent definitions, proposed agents, queued execution and completed evidence with distinct states. “Connected,” “verified,” “fresh,” “read-only” and “write-authorized” are different connection badges.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Large repository/graph surfaces are paginated/virtualized. The graph defaults to a project-centered bounded neighborhood with search, filters, temporal slider, unresolved nodes and an accessible equivalent table. Do not render billions of nodes in a browser. Selection opens provenance and authorized relationships; node/edge counts obey permission boundaries.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Architecture | System/dependency graph, decisions, boundaries, migration plans and fitness checks |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Innovation | Opportunity hypotheses, prototypes, experiments, alternatives and validation outcomes |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Every panel response includes tenant/project scope, observation time, source/projection version, coverage and confidence where applicable. A partial BFF composition preserves working panels and labels failed/stale ones. Unknown data never becomes a green zero. Dashboard actions point to the relevant policy-controlled command, not direct database writes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Connect account → review provider grant → select resources → inspect ingestion coverage → inspect intelligence → launch objective → inspect plan/budget → observe execution → review evidence/candidate → authorize repository or environment action → observe provider receipt and outcome. GitHub app registration, installation and account consent must be separate visible steps with a safe return path. Hosted AI account availability is explained without replacing unavailable execution with a fake login button.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Persistent activity records let a user resume after interruption. Forms preserve input on retryable failures but never retain secret values in client storage. An unknown side effect shows “reconciling” and disables duplicate dispatch. Canceled/revoked work shows actual stopped versus already-dispatched effects. Approval screens summarize target, exact change, test coverage, risks, cost, expiry and rollback/forward recovery.

occurrences.statement: ## Accessibility and design verification
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Semantic navigation, heading hierarchy, labels, keyboard commands, focus management, announcements, contrast, reduced motion, readable type and zoom/mobile layouts are release criteria. Graph/3D/score visualizations need text/tabular alternatives and evidence drilldown. Voice outputs are accompanied by text and explicit editable intent. Color alone cannot communicate severity, completeness or permission.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Test critical journeys on representative browsers/devices, keyboard-only and assistive technology; evaluate latency and interruptions with real backend states. Conduct usability research separately from cosmetic screenshot review. Every dashboard metric has a methodology/source tooltip or detail panel, and all simulated/forecast values are labeled. Design changes are versioned with implementation tasks and acceptance evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A plugin is a signed immutable release containing manifest, publisher identity, runtime/module digest, requested capabilities, supported API versions, configuration schema, declared tool endpoints, resource classes, data destinations, dependency/SBOM manifest, evaluation results and rollback/upgrade constraints. Components can include connector adapter, parser/scanner, sandbox tool, agent template, UI extension, twin model or domain evaluator. Each kind has a distinct capability contract.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Manifest fields include `plugin_id`, `version`, `publisher`, `artifact_digest`, `signature`, `min_platform_api`, `capabilities`, `network_destinations`, `data_classifications`, `residency_support`, `execution_profile`, `tool_schemas`, `billing_model`, `license`, `compatibility` and `provenance`. Installation pins digest/version, tenant/project scope and approved capabilities. An upgrade requesting new permissions requires fresh approval; no mutable “latest” bypasses review.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Server plugins execute in restricted services or sandbox pools through the Tool Broker. Declarative UI plugins render in isolated frames with a typed host bridge and restrictive content/security policy; they receive selected authorized view data, not ambient session tokens. Native/desktop plugins need code signing and OS grant boundaries. Prompt templates are untrusted instructions unless incorporated into a reviewed template policy; they cannot redefine platform authority.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Publisher registration/identity verification → signed submission → malware/dependency/license review → isolation and permission tests → domain-quality evaluations → review/risk tier → immutable published release → tenant installation consent → monitored execution → revocation/update/rollback. Security emergency revocation blocks new execution and invalidates capabilities; existing outputs retain provenance and may need re-evaluation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Marketplace discovery shows evaluated capability, supported environments, permissions/data destinations, cost model, update history and independent review results. Ratings distinguish task evidence from subjective feedback and detect abuse/Sybil activity. Publisher payout uses the billing ledger, settlement windows, refund/chargeback reserves and verified tax/payment onboarding handled by a supported financial provider. No platform agent may autonomously accept financial/legal terms or install a privileged plugin globally.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: An agent template supplies specialization, prompt/instruction digest, input/output schemas, required tools, memory selectors, supported models, evaluation rubric, cost limits and collaboration policy. It has no credentials or inherited grants. Tenant administrators can restrict models/tools/publishers and require internal review before use. Agent templates are data consumed by the Agent OS; purchasing a template does not grant production deployment authority.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A template promotion compares held-out task quality, unsupported claims, security violations, regression rate, latency and cost against the prior version. Correlated model reviewers and contaminated evaluation sets are disclosed. Enterprise private marketplace supports organization-specific templates with no public leakage of source or business strategies.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: All 47 domains in `../UNFINISHED-WORK/11-specialist-domains.md` use the same agent/task/evidence protocol. Root swarms group execution capability without forcing every specialty into a separate service. Security/Cyber Defense/Penetration Testing require authorized targets and reviewed tools. Backend/Frontend/Mobile/Testing/QA produce behavioral implementation and tests. DevOps/Cloud/Infrastructure/Networking produce scoped plans and deployment evidence. Database specialists validate integrity/migrations/recovery. AI/ML/LLM/RAG/vector specialists evaluate data/model/retrieval quality and privacy.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 3D/Blender/Maya/Unity/Unreal/Game specialists use version-aware scene/asset adapters, sandboxed GPU/licensed pools, deterministic artifact manifests and render/playability/performance checks. UI/UX/Accessibility use task journeys and assistive evidence. Documentation/Research/Open Source/Dependency specialists retain source/version/licensing provenance. Business/Product/Customer/Revenue/Competitive/Innovation/Future specialists distinguish observations, hypotheses and validated experiments. Compliance/Legal specialists map scoped controls and qualified-review requirements rather than certify outcomes autonomously.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: New technologies create proposed domain/template registrations, not instant privileged tools. The discovery workflow gathers references, drafts schemas/evaluations, performs review and then admits a versioned specialist. Emergency/investigation agents inherit incident scope, expiry and budget and retire after the incident. Temporary agents and permanent departments share retained lineage and auditable retirement.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 4. Verify/deduplicate receipts, compute cost using the dispatch-bound rate card and settle consumed portion. Release unused reservation at terminal state, retaining pending amounts for unresolved provider outcomes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: An unknown provider response can consume billable usage. Do not release its full reservation or blindly call again until reconciled or the unresolved liability is explicitly accounted for. A small internal exposure reserve can cover legitimate post-dispatch price/usage variance; do not silently enlarge the user's approved root budget. Stop future dispatch if exposure exceeds policy.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Support organization subscriptions/seats, consumption credits, enterprise committed use, dedicated infrastructure charges and marketplace tool/template charges. Entitlements define allowed capabilities and quotas, not security permissions. Seat ownership/provisioning reconciles with organization membership; removing a user need not erase their historical audit.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Account-based model plan usage is metered separately from platform fees. If a customer's ChatGPT or other eligible account plan pays the model provider, OmniDev must not label that usage as its own API charge or bill twice for the same pass-through item. Display actual billing path, any separate platform/compute/plugin charges and remaining provider-plan availability if supported. A provider plan limit cannot trigger silent API-key fallback or a new financial obligation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Payment/invoice integration uses a supported payment service provider, idempotent invoice/payment operations and signature-validated webhook ingestion. Tax, payment onboarding and contractual credit/refund rules require qualified implementation/review. No real financial account or spending authority is established by this design.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Dimensions: tenant, workspace, project, repository, root run, agent/template, swarm, provider/model, tool/plugin, environment, region/cell, resource class and initiative. Provide actual, reserved, estimated and reconciled values separately. Identify repeated failed runs, low-quality expensive templates, embedding refresh waste, idle compute and cross-cloud egress. Cost recommendations include expected savings, switching/quality/residency risk and verification experiments.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Threshold policies can pause optional work, lower configured concurrency, require review or schedule off-peak compute. They cannot switch models, reduce security checks or export data to another region without compatible explicit policy. Enterprise chargeback uses declared allocation rules and includes shared infrastructure overhead with an explainable basis.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Analytical results tolerate late arrivals and explicit corrections; financial ledger remains the authoritative billed amount. Query quotas and suppression/minimum-group rules protect shared/global aggregates. Attribution and causality are distinct: a conversion correlated with a feature is not proven caused by it. Customer/business analytics sources retain their own permissions and retention.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Quality controls reconcile event counts, duplicate IDs, schema drift, missing usage receipts and tenant deletion propagation. Platform-growth metrics never replace task correctness, security or actual customer outcomes as agent evaluation goals.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Select a horizontally scalable time-series implementation with verified tenancy, retention and HA behavior; VictoriaMetrics-compatible regional deployment is the reference family, subject to a specific version/replication design during provisioning. Keep metrics, log and trace storage independently sized. Initial metrics: high-resolution 30 days, downsampled 13 months; debug logs 7 days, ordinary operational logs 30 days, traces 7–30 days by sampling. Audit/financial evidence follows separate retention/legal policy. These are proposed defaults, configurable by residency and contract.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Alert on user-visible SLO burn rate, stale workers, policy authority/fencing failure, duplicate external operations, ledger imbalance, source/graph staleness, excessive output/egress and sandbox anomalies. Thresholds derive from measured baseline; silence is not a green health state. Alerts carry affected projects, severity, evidence links, owner and runbook. Incident/notification connectors require selected recipients/channels and do not send arbitrary autonomous messages.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reference Omni Score weights for the thirteen requested dimensions: Security 15, Architecture 10, Code Quality 8, Innovation 5, Performance 8, Scalability 8, Reliability 12, Maintainability 7, Developer Experience 5, User Experience 5, AI Readiness 5, Business Opportunity 7, Future Readiness 5 (sum 100). Tenant methodology may override with a versioned approved profile.

occurrences.statement: For eligible dimensions, aggregate `sum(weight × coverage × value) / sum(weight × coverage)` and separately display weighted coverage. Do not impute missing dimensions as 100. Score is provisional unless weighted coverage ≥80% and required security/reliability evidence is fresh. An unresolved verified critical risk adds a prominent blocker and reference policy caps Omni Score at 49; accepted risk remains visible and its governance is explicit. Calibration and fairness across project types require evaluation before using scores for commercial guarantees or employee assessment.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Repository intelligence score applies the technical subset with coverage normalization and methodology version; business dimensions remain unassessed unless data exists. Score histories bind source and measurement windows so trend changes distinguish real improvement from a new scoring algorithm.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Show project/security/architecture health, debt, innovation and revenue opportunities, scaling risks, future projections and Omni Score. Drilldown traces every number to evidence, coverage, source revision and action. Separate measured current health, incomplete scan, proposed opportunity and future scenario. Ranking across projects uses comparable methodology and flags incomparable coverage. A revenue hypothesis never becomes booked revenue.

occurrences.statement: The reference SQL in `contracts/core-schema.sql` defines the core control entities, leasing, operation idempotency, reservations, receipts, outbox/inbox and RLS. It is a design artifact, not a migration already applied to the current SQLite/D1 application. Every service adds its domain schema from the table contracts above during implementation with versioned tests and scoped database grants.

occurrences.statement: Run creation transaction validates project membership/policy, locks relevant budget, reserves maximum, inserts immutable input manifest/run and outbox fact. Task claim atomically increments fencing token and attempt under lease preconditions. Completion checks state, authority epoch, fence and input digest; output/artifact validation is separate from dispatch authorization. Active-job limits use a locked quota/reservation aggregate, not an unprotected COUNT query.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Repository/deployment intent records operation ID and target/payload hash before external dispatch. Unknown outcomes enter reconciliation. Provider receipt uniqueness plus effect intent protects against retries; database transactions cannot roll back a remote provider after commit. Stale approvals, source revisions and lease reports cannot overwrite newer state.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Tenant RLS does not replace fine-grained project/action policy. Tenant context is set only by trusted server code after membership authentication; end users cannot open SQL sessions. Privileged maintenance roles are separate, audited and not exposed to normal services. Backup/CDC/publication roles are reviewed for data leakage.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Deletion workflow: freeze new ingestion → revoke access/grants → invalidate query policy/cache immediately → tombstone entity/edge/memory/chunk references → delete derived stores/objects according to holds → record backup expiry/key destruction → replay tombstone ledger during restore → verify completion. A tombstone without physical cleanup is not a completed deletion. Analytics/global-pattern pipeline uses consent and deletion lineage; aggregate retention requires a documented privacy/legal basis.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: These decisions are selected target architecture. Product/legal/procurement details such as provider registration, managed-service editions, locations and financial terms remain implementation prerequisites, not undecided core topology. Significant changes need a new ADR with measured evidence and migration consequences.

occurrences.statement: A home cell holds a renewable signed ownership lease with a conservative expiry and fencing epoch. New privileged dispatch requires a valid local lease and fresh regional policy/financial authority. During loss of placement quorum, allowed reads continue; new ownership cannot be promoted, and writes stop when the home lease expires. Promotion waits for proof of old fencing or lease expiry plus clock/skew margin. A customer target adapter verifies current epoch before sensitive side effects where supported; otherwise the broker's exclusive authority and receipt reconciliation are required. This sacrifices write availability during uncertain ownership to prevent split-brain changes.

occurrences.statement: Dual projections may compare reads, but command writes have one authority at a time. Keep an approved fallback until no post-cutover effects would be overwritten. Encrypted secrets require supported secure key handling/re-authorization, not plaintext CSV exports.

Evaluate new models/parsers/algorithms against held-out task/data sets, authorization constraints, quality/cost and source licenses before promotion.

Synthetic capacity tests and real customer observations remain separately labeled.
