occurrences.statement: Deployment manifests, full domain migrations and complete service-specific API specs are implementation deliverables derived from this package; the core reference contracts are not advertised as an already running production platform.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The knowledge journal service owns canonical entity identities, observations and versioned assertions in PostgreSQL plus immutable object manifests. Source systems retain authority over their own facts. An observation is what a particular collector saw, not an omniscient statement about reality. Neo4j, lexical search, Qdrant and analytical rollups are rebuildable projections. No model writes directly into authoritative stores. A model proposes assertions through a validation and adjudication command.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Separate four representations: source artifacts; extracted claims; accepted knowledge views; generated answers. They have different retention, reliability and access rules. The accepted view includes disputed and unknown states rather than erasing ambiguity. Accepted means the admission criteria were satisfied, not that a statement can never be wrong.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | CoverageManifest | expected domains, enumerated scope, successful/failed/excluded coverage, timestamps, collectors | Absence claims require applicable coverage, not missing search results |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Hypothesis | testable statement, supporting/refuting evidence, proposed intervention, outcome | Remains distinct from observation and forecast |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use UUID identities and source-local natural-key mappings. Deduplicate source observations by tenant, connection, revision, collector digest and partition. Content hashes deduplicate bytes only within the authorized encryption/deduplication boundary; identical bytes do not imply identical entities or owners. Identity mapping for functions uses repository lineage, parser-specific symbol identity and signature/context. Git rename similarity is a candidate signal; ambiguous moves remain separate entities linked by POSSIBLE_SUCCESSOR.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Every discovered item receives a structural containment link to its source/context, provenance link to an observation and an ownership state. This meets navigable connectivity without fabricating semantic dependencies. Unknown owners point to an explicitly typed UnresolvedOwner record; broken references point to UnresolvedReference. These represent missing knowledge, not real users or confirmed external services. Tenant root is the terminus of containment. Semantic isolation is measurable even when structural connectivity exists.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Gaps and access | KnowledgeGap, Requirement, Policy, Grant, UnresolvedReference, UnresolvedOwner | APPLIES_TO, REQUIRES, BLOCKS, GOVERNED_BY |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: CloudResource has provider-qualified subtype and external ID; Container records image digest and runtime occurrence, not merely image tag. Logs are indexed batches and selected evidence spans, not billions of individual graph nodes by default. Customer interactions minimize personal data and retain authorized source pointers. 3D assets map scene hierarchy, mesh/material/rig, dependencies, license and exporter revision through extension subtypes. AIModel identifies weights/provider revision, capabilities, license and evaluation context; a marketing model name alone is not reproducible identity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: CONTAINS is an acyclic structural parent relation within a context; CALLS and DEPENDS_ON may legitimately cycle. Track cycle meaning by strongly connected components, not by globally banning cycles. CALLS requires parser/static-analysis/runtime evidence; MENTIONS is textual mention and cannot be promoted to dependency. READS/WRITES attach operation and environment context. RESPONSIBLE_FOR is explicit ownership, not inferred from a single commit. CHANGED_BY records commit authorship separately from deployment actor and decision maker. Business AFFECTS relationships need measured evidence or hypothesis modality.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: All edges carry source assertion ID, evidence, validity, modality and access scope. Relationship visibility requires authorization on both endpoints and the relation/evidence. Projection filters must not expose denied endpoint names, counts, degree, paths or inferred membership. Shared public dependencies are public corpus entities; tenant-private usage edges remain private.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Ontology migrations are versioned: additive labels first, adapters dual-read old and new representations, replay into shadow projections, compare semantics and coverage, then promote. Unknown extension types stay namespaced and quarantined from strong reasoning rules until reviewed. Extensions declare property types, relation domain/range, cardinality, required evidence and license. Keep original extracted type alongside normalization to preserve fidelity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: PROV-compatible export maps source objects to entities, extraction/evaluation operations to activities and responsible principals to agents. This is interoperability mapping, not a claim of complete OWL reasoning support. Sign journal batch manifests, preserve extractor and model versions and content hashes, and record derivation DAGs. Do not store private model chain-of-thought; preserve concise rationales, evidence references, rule executions and reviewer decisions sufficient to explain outputs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Each memory record contains tenant_id, memory_id, layer, scope_id, subject_entity_ids, memory_kind, modality, state, content_artifact, source_assertion_ids, evidence_ids, created_by, created_at, valid_range, recorded_range, confidence_method, salience, sensitivity, access_policy_id, retention_policy_id, consent_basis, supersedes_id and retrieval_generation. Summaries additionally declare input manifests, compression version, covered intervals, omissions and summary fidelity evaluation. Memory is indexed by reference; raw documents are not duplicated indiscriminately into every layer.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 1 Session | Current conversation, selected sources, tool receipts and unresolved questions | Checkpoint durable episodes; ephemeral scratch TTL 24 hours by default | Participant/resource grants; session membership alone cannot expose underlying sources |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 2 Agent | Specialized procedures, evaluations and reviewed individual lessons | Useful episodes admitted after evidence validation; task scratch expires | Agent identity plus current delegated scope; identity is not a private-data wildcard |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 3 Swarm | Shared investigation, hypotheses, disagreements and review outcomes | Append collaboration episodes; compact after run closure | Each reader's current grants; shared summaries obey restrictive source policy |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 5 Organization | Company decisions, approved operating practices and cross-project patterns | Explicit aggregation, steward review and lawful retention | Org policy and project-specific restrictions; org membership is insufficient |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 6 Global Pattern | Public lessons and consented, reviewed generalized patterns | Separate publication workflow; privacy review, leakage testing, withdrawal support | Public corpus or explicitly scoped sharing grants; no raw private tenant data |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 7 Innovation | Opportunities, invention hypotheses, novelty searches and experiments | Record authorship, source rights, confidentiality and test outcomes | Project/org or approved publication scope; patentability remains an unverified legal question |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | 8 Future | Scenario assumptions, forecasts, roadmap branches and predicted outcomes | Retain issued forecast unchanged; attach later evaluations and replacements | Source-derived access plus scenario policy; future memory never replaces observed present |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Decision memory is a cross-cutting kind available within these layers, not a ninth layer or separate source of contradictory truth. Research memory maps to semantic/episode records in agent, swarm, project or organization scopes. The earlier production document's short-term/company/global terms map to session/organization/global pattern. Its decision and research stores become typed views; innovation remains layer 7 and future is explicitly layer 8.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A memory command authenticates its writer, validates source manifests, applies classification, records consent/retention, computes idempotency key and appends a versioned entry plus outbox event. Eligible retrieval generation follows only after projection watermark advances. Rejected admission retains a minimal audit reason; harmful raw content need not be permanently preserved merely to record a rejection.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Consolidation clusters related episodes within a scope and creates an evidence-linked summary. It preserves dissent and exceptions, labels missing inputs and never deletes sources solely because a summary exists. Source retention and compaction are separate decisions. Before admitting a procedural lesson, require a generalization boundary: language/version/environment, triggering conditions, tested outcomes, contraindications and expiry/revalidation criteria.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Promotion from agent to swarm or project increases discoverability only after scope and provenance checks. Promotion to organization requires approved sharing. Global publication requires rights, explicit opt-in where applicable, confidential-data removal, membership/secret leakage testing, owner review and a withdrawal locator. Aggregation is not automatically anonymization. Do not globally train models on private memory by default. Revoked publication invalidates global indexes and downstream generated summaries identified through lineage.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Contradictions create a dispute set: conflicting assertions, overlapping context/valid intervals, evidence lineage, severity, owner and resolution criteria. Preserve both until adjudication. Human authority can settle a business choice but cannot retroactively prove a performance measurement. Retractions propagate to dependent summaries, vectors, graph projections, answers and automation prerequisites; revalidate descendants rather than silently leaving polished false memories.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A decision stores decision_id, scope, title, problem, triggering_evidence, author/proposer, accountable_decider, participants, decided_at, effective_at, alternatives, criteria/weights, selected_option, rationale, risks, mitigations, expected_outcomes, verification_plan, review_date, related_entities, implementation_refs, actual_outcomes, lessons, status and supersedes_id. Alternatives include rejected/deferred choices and reasons. Expected outcomes are measurable metrics with baseline, target, observation window, owner and assumptions. Actual outcomes include measurement method and attribution uncertainty.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Lifecycle: draft → under_review → accepted or rejected → implemented → evaluated → superseded or retired. Reopening does not mutate the historic accepted rationale: append a reconsideration record and link it. Decisions may expire or remain implemented while failing their expected outcomes. Capture disagreement and exceptions. Sign-off records authorized principal, exact decision revision, policy version and timestamp; a generated summary of a meeting is not participant approval.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The design supports indefinite retained history where permitted, not unconditional permanent storage of every personal record. Retention is configurable by kind, sensitivity, tenant contract and legal basis. Legal holds apply through authorized review. User deletion, consent withdrawal and confidential-source revocation propagate through derivation lineage and indexes. Backup restoration applies tombstones before reopening query service. Audit proof can retain non-content operation evidence only when permitted; hashes may themselves be sensitive and require policy review.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Every assertion has valid time (when the claim applies in its domain) and recorded time (when OmniDev knew it). Use half-open intervals [start,end) in UTC, retaining source timezone/precision where significant. A late incident report can change today's understanding of yesterday without rewriting what engineers knew yesterday. Transaction sequence and source revision order break timestamp ties; clock time alone does not provide distributed ordering.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Queries require valid_at, known_at, branch/environment and optional scenario_id. “Current” defaults to latest committed knowledge watermark and current valid time, returned explicitly. Historical queries must still use current access permissions: possession of a past grant is not a right to see revoked data now. Graph projections materialize current state for fast reads; archival bitemporal assertions reconstruct historical snapshots on isolated analytical workers. Projection lag is explicit.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Past and current states are observations or accepted claims. Future states are scenario branches, each with assumptions, parent baseline, forecast model/version, horizon, distributions or ranges where calibrated, uncertainty and evaluation dates. Year 1/3/5/10 are horizon labels, not guarantees. Version 1/2/3 are immutable release/snapshot references; planned versions are proposed scenarios until deployed evidence establishes a release. Never connect a forecast dependency as a confirmed present dependency.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 3. Normalize identifiers and parse in isolated workers. Language AST/LSP/build metadata outranks regex guesses; unsupported syntax reports incomplete coverage.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: 8. Run gap rules and invalidate affected summaries/answers by dependency lineage. Incremental changes reparse affected reverse dependencies under a budget.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Gap/ownership | subject/rule/version, coverage, owner, freshness | Find blind spots without treating missing authorization as missing documentation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Neo4j constraints enforce selected uniqueness and property contracts supported by the pinned edition. Service validation enforces domain/range, provenance, temporal consistency and cross-node policies; database constraints are not a complete ontology validator. Use version-qualified entity projection keys so historical versions do not violate current-identity uniqueness. Qdrant filtering must use trusted policy-derived filters; metadata ACL alone is not an authentication system.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Chunk source code by symbol and logical block, documents by section with heading lineage, conversations by topic episodes with speaker/time, decisions by rationale/alternatives/outcomes, and 3D assets by manifest/scene metadata plus supported multimodal features. Preserve parent IDs and exact source spans. Never split away the negation or conditions of a security policy. Large binaries remain in object storage; retrieval uses manifests/previews and authorized tool inspection.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Chunk IDs include artifact digest, selector and chunker version. Embeddings are indexed by model digest/version, dimension, tokenizer, normalization, distance metric and language/domain evaluation. Store separate generations for incompatible models. Build shadow index, replay deltas, compare recall/latency/isolation and switch a routing generation after gates; do not mix dimensions or scores across incomparable spaces. Lexical retrieval remains available when embeddings fail, within identical policy and provenance boundaries.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Knowledge Registry owns ontology/identity. Journal owns canonical observations/assertions. Temporal View composes snapshots. Memory Admission and Consolidation manage scoped memories. Retrieval Planner selects search and graph plans. Evidence Resolver fetches authorized pinned artifacts. Reasoning Runtime evaluates rules, explanations and hypotheses. Gap Engine produces coverage-conditioned findings. Evaluation Service scores answers/forecasts. All run per home cell behind the platform's policy service and immutable audit trail; they do not add a second cross-cloud writer.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: E --> R["Rules and hypothesis evaluation"]
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: R --> V["Claim verification"]
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The planner resolves pronouns/entities, intent, scope, valid/known times, release/environment and permission filters. Ambiguous API names require scoped disambiguation before effects or strong conclusions. Search returns candidate identifiers; evidence resolver reads authoritative policy and source validity before exposing content to a model. Structured graph expansion uses allowlisted query templates rather than model-generated unrestricted Cypher.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Default interactive budget: graph depth 4, 1,000 nodes, 5,000 edges, 2 seconds graph work; 200 lexical plus 200 vector candidates, fused to 100, at most 30 reranked and 12 evidence chunks initially. Context target is 24,000 tokens, reduced to provider limit and tenant policy. Retrieval p95 target remains 1.5 seconds for the bounded candidate phase; full cited answers have a separate 15-second first-complete-answer target under reference workload, not guaranteed provider latency. Deep investigations become asynchronous operations with explicit cost, expansion and deadlines.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Fuse lexical and vector rankings using reciprocal rank fusion with k=60 as a tunable baseline; do not add raw BM25 and cosine values. Reranking models are replaceable, evaluated for domain/language suitability and bounded by budget. Graph facts score by evidence relevance, freshness, context match and authority. Popularity/centrality can prioritize discovery but cannot overpower permission or establish factual correctness. Evidence from diverse independent origins improves corroboration; duplicate derivations are collapsed.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Structural | Typed graph traversal, reverse dependency closure, strongly connected components | Known dependencies within declared parser/runtime coverage |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Decision | Traverse rationale, alternatives, accepted risks and outcome evidence | Recorded reasons; undocumented intent remains unknown |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Diagnostic | Symptoms → dependency/telemetry correlation → competing hypotheses → discriminating tests | Root cause requires reproducible/test/intervention evidence |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Risk | Threat/dependency/policy/ownership graph plus applicability and exposure evidence | Scoped risk findings; uncertainty attached |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Opportunity | Gap/business objectives/experiments/market evidence → ranked proposals | Opportunity hypothesis pending validation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Forecast | Scenario baseline, constraints, calibrated model, horizon and assumptions | Conditional projection, never current fact |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Rules have rule_id/version, allowed types/predicates, preconditions, confidence class, evidence requirements, materialization policy, expiry and explanation template. Evaluate recursion with stratified rule dependencies, bounded fixed points and cycle detection. Avoid unbounded OWL closure across all tenants. Derived facts retain dependency lineage and invalidate on source retraction. Negation is permitted only within declared closed coverage for that predicate/context; global world knowledge is open and incomplete.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: No answer-generation agent can approve its own evidence admission, modify policy or perform remediation. Reasoning produces proposals; tool effects use the existing exact-target capability/approval system. Prompt injection in code, logs, tickets and documentation is untrusted data. Retrieval messages label origin and quoted data, separate instructions from evidence, strip executable directives from summaries, and prevent content-triggered tool grants. Suspicious material is retained only under appropriate security policy and displayed with neutral evidence context.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: An answer contains answer_id, question/context/time, snapshot_manifest, claims, evidence_refs, concise rationale, competing hypotheses, unknowns, retrieval coverage, projection lag, model/rule versions, confidence method, recommended next steps and expires_at. Each claim is labeled observed, recorded_decision, inferred, hypothesis or forecast. Citation selectors bind to artifact digest and exact source span. Claim verifier checks cited support, conflicting sources, context/time mismatch, numerical derivation and source accessibility. Unsupported claims are removed, reframed as hypotheses or cause abstention.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Store concise explanations and structured derivation traces, not hidden chain-of-thought. A model can summarize a trace but cannot fabricate tool results. Answers cache by tenant/principal policy fingerprint, normalized question, temporal context, source generation and model/rule version; revocation and lineage changes invalidate caches. Shared answer caches must not leak private evidence through timing, keys, existence or response counts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | How does this work? | Source symbols + data/control paths + API/runtime traces | Parser/build references and matching runtime context |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What depends on this? | Reverse dependency traversal across permitted partitions | Scoped closure and explicit unresolved/dynamic coverage |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What breaks if removed? | Impact set plus isolated build/test and contract simulation | Actual sandbox receipts; graph reachability alone is potential impact |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What should replace this? | Requirements, candidate compatibility, cost, security and migration tests | Multi-criteria proposal with experiments and decision owner |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Where is this bug coming from? | Error signatures → failing tests → changed symbols → dependencies | Reproduction and controlled fix/rollback outcome |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What should be built next? | Objectives → gaps → dependencies → effort/risk/value evidence | Ranked proposal with assumptions, owner and validation plan |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What security risks exist? | Exposure/configuration/dependencies → applicable advisories/controls | Pinned revisions and validated applicability, not keyword matches alone |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | How can revenue grow? | Revenue funnel → customer interactions → product gaps → experiments | Measured business baseline and lawful data; no unsupported revenue promises |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | What should happen next? | Unresolved critical risks, accepted priorities, dependencies and budgets | Authorized recommendation; action requires separate effect approval |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: For an unknown dependency or inaccessible project, disclose that visible analysis is incomplete without revealing hidden object existence. UI may say “coverage limited by available authorized sources,” not “a secret service exists.” Human correction starts a review and appends evidence; user satisfaction alone does not train factual certainty.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: Missing knowledge and organizational blind spots
occurrences.statement: # Missing knowledge and organizational blind spots
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Classify results as confirmed_within_scope, suspected, unknown_due_to_coverage, not_applicable or resolved_with_evidence. Severity derives from impact and exposure; confidence derives from evidence. These are separate axes. Preserve a high-severity unknown instead of lowering its priority merely because evidence is incomplete. Gap resolution requires accepted evidence and rerunning the same applicability rule, not just a user clicking “done.”
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Knowledge | Critical entity has unanswered required questions or disputed operational claims | Source-linked answers accepted and contradiction disposition recorded |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Documentation | Required runbook/API/decision type absent from fully enumerated allowed source scope | Current document linked, ownership and recovery procedure validated |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Architecture | Service/flow lacks a required boundary, interface or accountable design | Accepted architecture decision plus implementation inspection where required |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Security | Applicable control missing or stale for actual exposure | Verified configuration/test and current source coverage |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Team knowledge | Critical system has no reviewed handoff or only one independently verified operator | Demonstrated second operator rehearsal and maintained documentation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Single point of failure | Dependency/resource/ownership cut set blocks critical objective | Tested redundancy/failover or explicitly accepted risk |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Team analysis uses explicit role/ownership, runbook exercise and handoff evidence. Commit counts, meeting attendance and message volume are weak proxies and must not become employee performance rankings. Users can correct identity and ownership mappings. Exclude private personal communications without explicit authorized scope. Explain organizational risk as system continuity, not speculative judgments about individuals.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Build an objective → service → resource → owner → recovery-capability graph. Compute bounded articulation/cut-set candidates on authorized projections, then validate against runtime architecture and recovery tests. A graph articulation point is a topology signal, not proof of production outage inevitability. Model shared failure domains such as cloud region, identity service, certificate authority, vendor API, sole on-call operator and budget authority.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Blind-spot prediction combines overdue reviews, unowned changes, stale source coverage, repeated unresolved incidents and contradictory decisions. Default output is a hypothesis with an investigation plan. Forecasts require backtesting on prior incidents, calibrated uncertainty, time-separated validation and explanation of missing signals. Do not claim to predict an invisible gap without evidence of the detection method's performance.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Detection emits gap.detected with exact evidence and coverage version. Triage validates applicability, assigns accountable owner and deadline, and links to ticket/workflow. A repair candidate proposes documentation, test, control or architecture changes. Verification independently checks resulting evidence and closes the finding only at the correct revision. Regression/staleness reopens it with history. Suppression requires named decision, reason, expiry and accepted risk; hidden permanent dismissals are disallowed.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Prioritization uses criticality, blast radius, uncertainty, dependency blocking, time sensitivity, business objective relevance and estimated repair effort. Weights and policy versions are visible and editable by authorized owners. Revenue opportunity predictions remain separate from confirmed engineering defects. Alert deduplication uses subject/rule/context fingerprint; meaningful scope or rule-version changes create linked revisions, not silent overwrites.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Operator dashboard shows knowledge coverage by domain, unresolved identity, stale assertions, conflicts, critical unowned systems, invalidated summaries, ingestion failures and pending adjudication. Executive dashboard presents risks with uncertainty and accountable actions. Coverage score measures enumerated evidence completeness, not “percentage of all possible knowledge.” Unknown denominator is displayed as unknown.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reuse the platform's 100 mature-cell planning model: 5 billion entity nodes and 20 billion relationship edges across cells, averaging 50 million nodes and 200 million edges per cell. These are capacity targets to qualify, not measured capabilities. Further partition a cell by organization/project groups and hot workload; giant tenants receive dedicated partitions. A graph partition is not automatically a complete cell or a database per small tenant.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Canonical identity metadata and assertion journal partition by tenant/project/time as volume dictates; small tenant partitions are grouped physically. Hot current views remain in indexed transactional/graph stores. Historical revisions and extracted batches live in columnar/object archives with manifest indexes. Avoid storing source bodies or complete logs on every graph edge. Estimates for 20 billion edges at 160 bytes raw are 3.2 TB before index/metadata/replication; real storage sizing must measure typed properties, temporal versions and history retention, which can dominate current-state data.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: At 10 billion vectors, 1536 float32 dimensions alone occupy 61.44 TB before graph/index/payload/replicas. Quantization may reduce vector bytes but requires measured retrieval loss and library-specific overhead; never infer quality from compression ratio. Tier by access frequency and rights. Record per-tenant cost for extraction, parsing, embedding, indexes, retrieval, model tokens, archival restore and adjudication. Root query budgets include subqueries and agent recursion, so multiplying experts cannot escape cost ceilings.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: High-degree package/platform hubs use typed fanout pages, scoped materialized summaries and async dependency closure. Cache generation-keyed authorized adjacency rather than entire tenant graphs. Do not precompute all-pairs transitive closure. Incremental invalidation batches descendants and labels stale derived results during bounded recomputation; effect gates require fresh underlying evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Rebuild into new graph/vector/lexical generations from signed snapshots and journal deltas. occurrences.statement: Initial proposed quality thresholds: citation-support precision ≥98%, forbidden-content disclosure zero in release corpus, entity resolution precision ≥99.5% with explicit unresolved recall, retrieval recall@50 ≥90% for answerable benchmark cases, correct abstention ≥95% on intentionally unanswerable questions. These are release targets to validate and refine by risk/domain, not achieved scores. Sampling confidence intervals, difficult slice results and false-positive/false-negative costs accompany aggregate metrics. One passing aggregate cannot hide a failing tenant-isolation or security slice.

Use the production event envelope, exact tenant/context/entity references, aggregate sequence, epoch and evidence/artifact references. No sensitive raw content in event payloads. occurrences.statement: Ingestion lifecycle: discovered → collecting → collected → parsed → proposed → admitted → projecting → searchable; failures may enter retryable, quarantined or coverage_partial. An operation's searchable stage requires all mandatory projections for its declared retrieval mode; it may provide lexical-only mode when semantic generation is unavailable. Memory lifecycle uses proposed/accepted/disputed/superseded/retracted. Global publication uses draft → rights_review → privacy_review → owner_approved → indexed → withdrawn. Skipping reviews is a policy violation, not a performance optimization.

occurrences.statement: The ontology catalog covers all 40 requested entity types. Chapter 1 defines schemas and connected provenance. Chapter 2 defines all eight memory layers and every decision field. Chapter 3 provides past/current/future timeline, indexing and source processing. Chapter 4 defines reasoning for every requested question and retrieval stages. Chapter 5 covers all eight missing-knowledge categories and organizational blind spots. Chapter 6 defines billion-edge scaling, security, recovery, quality and production gates. This chapter defines APIs/events and implementable delivery order. Reference JSON schemas, examples and SQL supplement the prose rather than replacing all service migrations.

Global routing discovers home cells and public templates; private memory and decisions remain within authorized residency. Root objectives may span permitted projects through delegated child work, not by granting global access to one agent.

occurrences.statement: The requested ten labels are supported, but activity and lifecycle are not forced into a contradictory single scalar. Durable lifecycle is Created, Learning, Active, Dormant, Archived, Retired or Destroyed. Busy, Reviewing and Collaborating are activity substates of admitted execution. The API exposes a primary display_state from this composition plus all concurrent activities. An agent can review one task while collaborating on another under concurrency limits; no information is lost by choosing a display label.

occurrences.statement: Swarm reorganization considers task dependency/locality, competence, reviewer independence, workload and cost. Model proposes topology; deterministic controller validates policy, DAG/cost lineage, membership conflicts and open reviews. Rebalance at checkpoints; running effectful attempts keep ownership/fence until reconciled. Objective authority remains singular per generation. Cross-cell collaboration uses delegated messages/tasks and consented evidence references, not shared unrestricted database state.

occurrences.statement: Allocation uses iterative traversal with paginated descendants, bounded fixed-point planning and an aggregate fanout limit per root. Spawn loops are detected by repeating objective/template/context signatures and declining marginal evidence. Cooldowns and admission queues prevent agent explosions. Agent recursion cannot reset deadline, maximum turns, money or review independence.

occurrences.statement: Objectives describe desired outcome, accountable owner, target scope, source snapshot, priority, acceptance metrics, budget, deadline and risk policy. Objective queue entries link dependencies and decisions. A task is a bounded contribution with task_id, objective_id, root_run, task_class, target/input digests, priority, urgency/deadline, complexity estimate, required skill predicates, dependency IDs, risk level, expected outcome, machine/human success criteria, allowed capabilities, evidence requirements, timeout/retry/compensation policy and resource reservation. All fields are versioned and tenant scoped.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Tasks transition proposed → validated → blocked or ready → claimed → running → awaiting_review → succeeded. Attempts may fail, retry_wait, canceled, timed_out or reconcile_unknown. Approval/provider/source dependencies use named waiting conditions, not repeated retries. Dependency completion requires accepted artifacts at exact revisions; successful predecessor from a different source snapshot cannot accidentally unblock an incompatible task.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Partition ready queues by home cell, tenant class and resource/task class. Weighted deficit round robin enforces tenant shares; per-tenant priority and age/deadline ordering select work within that share. Reserve a bounded incident share with borrowing when idle. Rate/concurrency/cost limits remain authoritative. Aging prevents starvation; admission refuses infeasible deadline/budget combinations with explanation instead of promising impossible work.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Eligibility first filters current grants, residency, compatible modules/model access, required skills and score freshness, resource pool availability, conflicts of interest and independent review requirements. Ranking then considers demonstrated task-class quality, estimated completion/cost, data locality and health. Trust and influence are advisory after hard constraints; high trust cannot override a denied target. Unknown competency routes to bounded learning/evaluation or a supervised task, not unlimited responsibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Agents request work through a broker. They do not select arbitrary highest-reward jobs or write SQL to mark themselves claimed. Scheduler allocates with an atomic transaction over task revision, ready/dependency state, agent capacity and budget reservation. Claim response binds attempt_id, fencing_token, authority_epoch, lease expiry, input digest, allowed target and resource reservation. Repeated request idempotency returns the same valid allocation rather than reserving twice.

Activity retries must not assume external exactly-once behavior. Use provider idempotency keys, operation ledgers and receipt/reconciliation; an uncertain database/deployment side effect cannot be retried blindly. Continue-As-New bounds long histories with explicit carryover manifests and root budget state. Large artifacts and conversations remain object references, not workflow history blobs.

occurrences.statement: Cancellation increments root cancel generation and revokes descendant dispatch rights. Current model calls may be noncancelable; retain uncertain-cost reservation until settled. Checkpointable tasks can be preempted at safe boundaries; noncheckpointable effect sections require drain/reconcile. Do not “undo” an irreversible external operation through a generic compensation label. Compensations are explicit tested actions with their own grants and approvals.

occurrences.statement: Repository work binds immutable snapshots and branches. Concurrent agents may generate separate candidates; integration locks or optimistic target revision checks serialize accepted application. Conflicts become merge/rebase review tasks. No agent can force-apply a stale candidate because its predecessor task succeeded. Production deploy and self-healing continue to use the previously specified twin/test/approval/canary/rollback gates.

occurrences.statement: All communications use a typed envelope: protocol_version, message_id, tenant_id, root_run, sender principal/generation, recipient/channel, kind, correlation_id, causation_id, sequence, occurred_at, expiry, classification, context_manifest, capability_reference, payload or artifact_ref, digest and trace_context. Kinds cover event, message, task_offer, request, response, review, debate_argument, peer_evaluation, vote and escalation. Schema-bound payloads prevent arbitrary instructions becoming dispatch commands.

Receipt acknowledgement proves journal acceptance, not understanding, task success or authorization. A signed review attests what that reviewer evaluated and its evidence digest, not absolute factual truth.

occurrences.statement: Round 1: share arguments as claim/evidence/risk/expected-outcome/uncertainty objects. Challenger names alternatives, assumptions and failure cases. Verifier identifies missing tests; security role checks nonnegotiable policy constraints.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Round 3: gather final recommendation per role and unresolved objections. Default at most three argument rounds, configurable down by budget. Completion requires role quorum and required evidence; timeout is inconclusive, not unanimous assent.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Decision: Omni Core applies deterministic gates first: current grants, valid target revision, no unaddressed policy veto, required tests, resource affordability and accountable approval tier. Eligible alternatives are ranked by the published rubric, with uncertainty and dissent preserved. A majority may recommend an option; it cannot override failing safety/authorization/test gates. Omni Core accepts ordinary preauthorized decisions through a service approval receipt. High-impact decisions route to the designated human/organizational authority. Model text “approved” is not an approval receipt.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The decision memory stores why/who/when, alternatives, risks, expected and actual outcomes, and lessons as specified in prompt 3. Record all criteria, weights, evidence and deviations. Consensus means governance chose an option; it does not turn an unsupported causal argument into truth. If no option qualifies, create a scoped investigation or escalate with a concrete unanswered question.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Every admitted agent participates in Observe → Analyze → Plan → Execute → Measure → Learn → Improve → Repeat under objective, scope and budget. “Continuous” means scheduled/event-triggered work with idle suspension, not unrestricted polling or infinite spending. Observe inputs are tool/test/incident receipts, reviewer feedback, measured outcomes and drift. Analyze generates hypotheses; plan specifies skill/workflow/reasoning candidate and evaluation criteria. Execute uses a bounded sandbox. Measure compares baseline with candidate on held-out cases. Learn records scope-limited lessons. Improve promotes only a passing version through admission and rollout.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Candidate upgrades include new skill manifests, approved tool adapters, workflow DAG templates, retrieval policies, reasoning/rule versions and domain guidance. Discovering a tool creates a review proposal with publisher, license, required grants, endpoints, failure modes and tests. It does not install code or call arbitrary APIs. Learned instructions never replace platform policy. Training/finetuning requires consented licensed data, cost approval and evaluation; no unreviewed online weight mutation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The evolution controller holds candidate digest, parent template, provenance, expected improvement, benchmark manifests, privacy/rights review, regression gates, runtime compatibility and rollback pointer. Evaluate security, task quality, unsupported claims, cost, latency and difficult domain slices. Separate train/validation/test by project/time; agents cannot edit their held-out answers or self-score promotion. Shadow evaluation precedes small canary cohort; policy and kernel changes require stronger independent review. Archive old immutable versions; running attempts pin one version to completion.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Promotion requires measurable benefit or an explicitly justified maintenance/security fix, no failing critical gate and bounded regression tolerance published before the experiment. Automatic promotion may apply to low-risk preauthorized guidance changes; tool permissions, policy, production actions and model/data changes follow corresponding approval tier. Drift or adverse incidents trigger downgrade/quarantine and evaluation, not silent denial of history.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Performance | Independently verified outcomes under task-class rubric | Scheduler ranking, coaching and qualification | Override permission or count self-reported completion |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Trust | Calibrated reliable behavior by domain/risk, verified incidents and freshness | Eligibility for supervised/preauthorized responsibility within existing grants | Mint grants, erase policy violations or become one universal probability |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Maintain per-domain score records: rubric/version, observation window, eligible samples, evidence, uncertainty, recency, adverse events and appeal status. Display unknown for insufficient samples. Use verified quality/cost/risk metrics instead of raw token/message/agent counts. Calibrate success estimates against outcomes; do not turn a 0–100 rubric score into a statistical probability. Confidence bounds and minimum samples qualify increased responsibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Credit ledger has transaction_id, tenant, account/agent, contribution/evaluation reference, amount as exact integer units, reason, version, occurred_at and reversal_of. Enforce unique contribution/reward-policy key; append reversals for invalidated evidence. No deletion of poor outcomes to improve scores. A shared-model echo or duplicated artifact gets no independent reward. Reuse credit is awarded only from verified beneficial use, with rights and provenance preserved. Roots cannot issue infinite credits to their own clones.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Anti-gaming detects collusive peer scoring, easy-task farming, duplicated findings, sybil clones, excessive spawning, artificial incident generation and cost externalization. Hold contested credit awards for independent evaluation. Scores cannot punish safety abstention or appropriate escalation. Review frequency and decay reflect evidence freshness, while historic harms remain auditable. A high-trust agent's increased responsibility still needs an authorized policy assignment and qualified action class.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Installable packs declare immutable module digest, publisher identity/signature, compatibility range, specialization/skill versions, workflow templates, reasoning rules, tool capability schemas, model constraints, knowledge references, dependencies, required destinations, data handling, licenses, SBOM, evaluation corpus/results, resource requirements, lifecycle hooks and rollback instructions. Examples: Security, Healthcare, Finance, Unity, Unreal, Blender, React and Data Science packs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Installation validates signature/supply chain, resolves pinned dependencies, compares requested grants, evaluates compatibility and stages in isolated environment. Agent profile may inherit declared skills automatically after successful installation, but tools and external access activate only within approved grants. Healthcare/finance packs supply specialized workflows, not professional/legal compliance certification. Unity/Unreal/Blender packs require compatible licensed local or remote workers; a pack icon does not prove an engine can run.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Updates with additional permissions require renewed applicable consent. Pin active runs; canary template versions; revoke malicious versions and block dispatch. Retain evidence of prior executions under audit policy. Marketplace agent templates remain untrusted code/content; UI extensions use sandboxed bridge APIs with no ambient credentials. Publisher trust never replaces artifact verification. Marketplace monetization belongs to the platform billing authority, not internal knowledge-credit conversion.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Sources include authenticated security detections, SLO burn/outage alerts, database health, deployment receipts and authorized revenue anomaly metrics. Each signal has source/context/time, severity, evidence, coverage and deduplication key. A revenue anomaly may be delayed/incomplete analytics, not an actual revenue loss. Confirm baseline, seasonality, collection failures and severity before high-impact interventions. Security suspicion triggers evidence preservation and containment planning; destructive cleanup is not the default first action.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Incident Controller correlates signals into an incident objective, binds affected repositories/services/environments and looks up approved runbook/expert roster. Spawn an incident commander, diagnostician, domain specialist, security reviewer where relevant, verifier and communication summarizer. Missing qualified resources escalate immediately with explicit waiting conditions; do not pretend a newly named emergency expert is competent.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reserve emergency capacity and allow safe checkpoint preemption of research/innovation work. Incident budget has an explicit ceiling and accountable owner; emergency authorization comes from configured runbook/policy, not severity words in a message. Broker can perform preapproved narrow actions such as rotating a scoped compromised grant, scaling within a tested ceiling or reverting a known compatible release if policy allows. Database destructive operations, uncertain rollback, major spend and broad credential changes follow high-impact approval.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Security breach | Validate alert, preserve audit/source evidence, map affected grants/assets and exposure | Scoped containment/remediation; verify revocation and remaining attack paths |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Major outage | Confirm user-impact SLO and dependency failure domain | Tested failover/rollback/scale within scope; monitor sustained recovery |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Incident lifecycle: detected → triaging → investigating → plan_ready → authorized → mitigating → verifying → recovered → learning → closed. Orthogonal blocked/reconcile_unknown conditions prevent false closure. Each plan states root-cause hypothesis, affected scope, exact candidate/runbook revision, expected metrics, stop conditions, rollback/compensation, approval and post-action monitoring window. Recovery requires independent verification and sustained SLO evidence; symptom relief can be recorded without pretending root cause is fixed.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Post-incident review appends timeline, decision rationales, expected/actual outcomes and lessons to project/org memory. Distinguish verified cause, contributor and unknown. Create regression tests and topology/ownership improvements. Never reward generating an incident or performing many actions; reward measured safe resolution and useful validated learning.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Tasks | DAG, ready/blocked/running/review, dependencies and acceptance | Named blocker and evidence rather than fake progress animation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Problems/risks | Incidents, gap findings, severity/confidence and owners | Confirmed versus suspected/unknown clearly labeled |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Future predictions | Scenario assumptions, horizon and evaluation | Forecast ranges/calibration, not guaranteed future |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Resources | Reserved/actual tokens, cost, CPU/GPU/memory, licensed workers | Actual receipts versus estimates and pending reconciliation |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use tenant/project/context filters with current policy on every stream. Realtime projector emits sequence/cursor updates; initial snapshot includes watermark, scope and lag. Slow clients receive resync_required. Reconnect resumes a signed cursor or fetches a fresh snapshot. Redaction and source revocation invalidate prior client projections where feasible and prevent future delivery; no historical grants replay.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Controls include pause/resume/drain, cancel root, request expert, start bounded investigation, review/approve exact candidate, inspect evidence, adjust authorized budget and retire identity. Confirmation/approval depends on action risk, not every harmless click. UI states explain provider authorization missing, unavailable worker, insufficient knowledge, awaiting approval, projection behind and uncertain external effect. Trace links are permission filtered.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Target millions of durable agents/tasks/repositories/decisions, with active execution constrained by measured capacity. A planning profile of 10 million registered agents and 100,000 simultaneous agent turns across 100 mature cells implies 100,000 agent identities and 1,000 active turns per average cell. This aligns with the production target profile; uneven load, giant tenants and hot incidents require additional partitions/dedicated cells. It does not mean 10 million simultaneous model requests or microVMs.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: At 100,000 active turns with a 20-second renewal interval, the logical attempt-renewal workload is 5,000 renewals/second globally, approximately 50 per average cell. This excludes controller/placement/worker leases and is an arithmetic target, not a benchmark. Batch renewal transport may reduce requests but each lease remains independently fenced and authoritative. Dormant agents have no compute heartbeat. Registering agents consumes metadata/index/history capacity and is not free.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: If average active turn lasts 30 seconds, 100,000 concurrency implies approximately 3,333 completed turns/second at steady state before failures/retries; arrival rate must stay below sustainable service capacity. Provider quotas, context sizes, GPU pools, tool licenses and spend limits may be more restrictive. Queue length does not equal compute throughput. Admission publishes estimated start/finish ranges based on measured rates, not one universal ETA.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Shard registry/task state by tenant/root objective and cell. Place task dependencies close to authoritative objectives, with indexed readiness counters and idempotent dependency receipts instead of repeatedly scanning millions of rows. Partition scheduler ownership with epoch-fenced controllers. Controller lease selects responsibility but does not itself authorize task effects. Bounded pagination and event-driven reconciliation avoid per-agent polling storms.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Cross-cell tasks are delegated operations with explicit parent context, budget allocation, target-cell receipt and source policy. Sender and receiver preserve one financial charge root and no global multiwriter. Intercell failures leave named waiting/reconcile states. No global barrier is required for unrelated objectives. Large company objectives split into independently accountable project work, with aggregate status derived from accepted child receipts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Registry/task/policy authorities run across availability zones per production topology. Temporal/Kafka and stores use separately qualified replication/backup profiles. Redis outage affects presence/cache and hints, not leases, budgets or completion authority. Model provider outage opens circuit breaker and queues work; alternate provider only when authorized by data/residency/model policy and actual grants. Do not hide provider differences in quality or cost.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: If policy authority is unreachable, new protected dispatch fails closed. Allowed read projections may remain available with freshness labels. Loss of home-writer lease stops writes/effects after expiry; new cell ownership requires fencing per the production placement protocol. Retryable reads do not grant permission to replay an unknown external write. Restored agent status is reconciled against task/operation receipts and current policy before returning Active.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use dead-letter quarantine and backpressure for malformed/poison messages, overloaded inference, stalled graph retrieval, unavailable licensed workers and excessive fanout. Maintain operational headroom for restore, incident capacity and index rebuild. Scale worker pools from queue age/resource class under cost ceilings, not raw agent count. No architecture claim assumes unlimited instant cloud capacity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A company simulation is an isolated scenario with synthetic or consented minimized data, business objectives, repositories, departments, agent modules, staffing/capacity, market/traffic/revenue assumptions and policy. It tests cooperation, task allocation, debate, delivery, incidents and evolution before production adoption. It has no production credentials or external effect permissions by default.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Scenario clock supports accelerated simulated time without falsifying actual audit timestamps. Simulated task durations/costs/outcomes are explicitly labeled; real sandbox tool runs produce real receipts linked separately. Thousands of agents may participate logically while compute concurrency remains bounded. Seeded randomness and pinned versions enable replay; stochastic model outputs are preserved for analysis rather than assumed deterministic.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Measure objective attainment, verified artifact quality, collaboration cost, dependency bottlenecks, task starvation, unresolved conflict, incident recovery, budget adherence, false confidence and knowledge propagation. Stress scenarios include contradictory decisions, noisy alerts, failing providers, poisoned packs, key employee/agent loss, scarce GPU/license capacity and cascading dependencies. Simulated discoveries/optimizations remain hypotheses until real qualified tests establish value.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Omni Core manages strategic objective queues, not an unchecked company ownership transfer. Humans set organization priorities, permitted effect classes, budget/residency constraints and accountable approval. Within those constraints, verified loops can continuously maintain/improve projects. Autonomous breadth grows only as evidence supports additional preauthorized action classes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: OmniDev Swarm — complete experience design specification
occurrences.statement: Prompt 5. UI/UX architecture, screen hierarchy, flows, wireframes, tokens, interactions, accessibility, client layouts and expansion. Design completion is separate from live implementation and usability validation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: OmniDev Swarm is a unified environment for directing an engineering organization of AI swarms. The interface helps a person understand what exists, choose what matters, inspect evidence, authorize work and verify outcomes. It does not require the person to understand model infrastructure before receiving value. Complexity lives in scoped drill-downs, not a wall of terminals. The full specification is prompt 5's target experience; current application features retain their actual availability and evidence states.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Five recurring questions organize every screen: What is happening? Why does it matter? What is known? What can I do? What happened after I acted? The default home answers “What should I focus on right now?” with a short ranked focus queue, not a conversational greeting. Research, forecasts and innovation show hypotheses as hypotheses. Active execution distinguishes model access, worker availability and waiting approvals.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The visual system takes information discipline from terminal software, source/review familiarity from developer platforms, spatial inspection from design tools, and coherent operational overview from mission control. These are functional inspirations, not copied branding or literal science-fiction holograms. Avoid endless glowing rings, decorative fake live metrics, spinning intelligence or animated agent chatter that adds no actionable information.
