occurrences.statement: Read actions use Open/View/Inspect/Compare. Planning uses Propose/Analyze/Plan/Simulate. Effectful actions use Apply/Create PR/Deploy/Revoke with explicit target. Avoid generic “Run AI” for every capability. Loading reports what is waiting and a cancellable operation when possible. Optimistic acceptance shows Submitted, not Completed. Display receipt time and source age separately.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Connection status: Available to connect, Consent pending, Connected read-only, Write-authorized, Expired, Revoked, Unavailable. Evidence status: Observed, Human asserted, Inferred, Hypothesis, Forecast, Disputed, Retracted. Execution: Queued, Running, Waiting provider, Waiting worker, Waiting approval, Reviewing, Succeeded with evidence, Failed, Canceled, Reconciling. These vocabularies are not interchangeable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+K command; Escape close popover/sheet or leave selection; slash focuses local search only outside editable fields and with shortcut disable option. Tab follows document order. Graph arrows/enter apply only when graph widget focused; global shortcuts do not trap ordinary navigation. Expert shortcut help is searchable and remappable where possible. No destructive single-key command without policy review.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ## Accessibility target and verification
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Support 200% zoom, text spacing changes and reflow at 320 CSS px with exceptions only for genuinely two-dimensional diagrams/tables paired with navigable alternatives. Touch controls favor 44 px; dense desktop targets meet minimum-size/spacing requirements. Tooltips and contextual information are available on keyboard focus and can be dismissed. Password manager/paste and accessible authentication options are supported; no required memorization puzzle without accessible alternative.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Reduced-motion disables panning animation, pulsing agent activity, parallax and simulated data flow; no flashing alert visualization. Theme follows preference with explicit override and persistent settings. High-contrast/forced-colors retains borders, focus, selection and icons. Voice has text input/output and captions; media/research recordings require appropriate captions/transcripts/descriptions. Errors connect to fields and an error summary; budgets/units are labeled.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Validate automated checks plus human keyboard/screen-reader/magnification tests on real implemented flows. Required journeys: sign-in/connect project, command clarification, evidence inspection, graph/table navigation, candidate review, approval/revision conflict, emergency recovery, agent pause/retire and mobile inbox. Test representative VoiceOver, NVDA and TalkBack combinations, browser zoom, reduced-motion/forced-colors and touch. A token contrast script cannot prove complete accessibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Wide 1440–1920: expanded rail, 12-column content and optional right inspector. Operational screens favor master/detail; maps fit center but default to meaningful bounds. Engineering diff can switch to focus mode hiding decorative/navigation density while context/target stays visible. Multi-monitor desktop may open scoped evidence windows; each retains active organization/environment and independent current authorization.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Portrait 320–767: 4-column stack; top context/command, Focus list, compact health summary, projects/work and discoveries in ordered sections. Bottom nav Focus/Projects/Swarms/Inbox/More with safe-area spacing. Mobile project uses scrollable tab selector with labels; never hides key context or approval warnings beneath a sticky bar. Charts use small multiples/table; graph opens full-screen and defaults to selected neighborhood or list.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Agent management on mobile shows status, blocker, current tasks and explicit pause/drain. Deep code editing/multi-panel architecture is supported through read/review and optional desktop handoff, not forced into a tiny mirrored desktop. High-impact approval shows exact target/evidence/cost with scroll landmarks, current revision and policy-required reauthentication. Push opens the authorized incident/decision, not instant approve buttons detached from evidence.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Offline reads show Cached/as_of and avoid sensitive overcaching. Expired sessions redact protected views. Draft comments may save encrypted locally if policy permits; production approvals/effects do not silently queue for later replay. Reconnect rechecks grants/source revision and explains conflicts. Poor networks retain inputs, show download/operation status and offer retry with idempotency, not duplicate actions.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Usability gates: first-time user can connect a project and find its first evidence-backed recommendation without developer help; executive can explain top risk and why a score is uncertain; engineer can locate source/test evidence and distinguish proposal from deployment; operator can identify provider/worker/approval blocker; keyboard-only user can complete the same key journeys. Measure success/errors/time and interview comprehension, not only clicks or session duration. Targets are set before testing and revised from evidence, not invented achievements.

occurrences.statement: Each new domain/integration/module registers namespaced navigation, typed view models, entity/graph semantics, command intents, prerequisites, action risk, permission selectors, evidence requirements, component surfaces and localization keys. Host decides placement; plugins cannot create unchecked top-level clutter or bypass the command/effect system. UI extensions use sandboxed bridge APIs with approved data and no ambient credentials.

occurrences.statement: Future clients may add spatial/voice/immersive views, but ordinary accessible text/table/navigation remains authoritative. 3D visualizations are optional tools for actual spatial/scene understanding, not mandatory decoration. New capabilities appear as available only after corresponding backend/grant/worker gates pass; planned features stay clearly labeled. Marketplace installation may add skills/intents after review, not a fake all-powerful “enabled” badge.

occurrences.section: OmniDev Swarm — master execution and company strategy
occurrences.statement: Prompt 6, corrected by Prompt 8 review. Full roadmap, MVP, team, technical, commercial, financing, risks and conditional ten-year plan. Financial numbers are planning assumptions, not actual revenue or guarantees.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: OmniDev Swarm should become the evidence and execution layer across an engineering organization's repositories, infrastructure, decisions and AI workers. The opening product is a repository-to-verified-improvement loop, not an attempt to launch all 47 departments, 39 connectors and ten-year predictions simultaneously. The long-term scope remains intact; sequencing protects quality, cash and credibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Initial ideal customer: a 5–30-person software team or development agency maintaining several JavaScript/TypeScript repositories, lacking a dedicated platform/security team, and spending material time understanding inherited code, triaging risks and validating small changes. Founder-led sales should test this customer definition, not assume it is proven. Avoid regulated production deployments, government procurement and 3D/game-engine automation as first customers unless a funded design partner supplies a narrow compatible use case.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Pain to solve: “I inherited a codebase, do not know where the risks are, and cannot safely turn AI suggestions into trustworthy fixes.” Promise: connect one repository, receive a source-linked risk/architecture brief, select a tractable issue, and obtain a reviewed candidate with test evidence and a draft PR. Outcome is faster verified resolution and better retained context. Do not claim universal vulnerability detection, perfect autonomy, novelty or a guaranteed financial valuation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Current foundation includes a private Sites console, bounded queue/leases/retries, heuristic snapshot analysis, memory/plans, candidate handling, account-first GitHub flows/adapters and a portable runner. The earlier 94 runtime/account acceptance checks mostly use stubbed provider/GitHub network interactions. Live model access, actual owner consent, isolated continuously running workers, real GitHub write verification and production self-healing are not established. Architecture, knowledge, AgentOS and experience packages are completed specifications, not completed production infrastructure.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: First commercial work converts the existing foundation into one real loop. Keep the canonical unfinished-work register and add concrete release gates. No report should equate documentation checks with deployed autonomy. Preserve Sites as present hosting; no mandatory Vercel dependency. Provider-account access is provider-specific: platform identity is not a model usage grant; unsupported hosted sign-in needs approval/registration or an explicitly authorized local execution path.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

These remain phase deliverables. A first-party pack registry may exist internally; selling a broad marketplace before supply-chain controls is not MVP value.

occurrences.statement: Single home region, managed transactional store for users/grants/jobs/usage, encrypted object artifacts, source-linked graph projection appropriate to supported data volume, lexical retrieval and optionally one evaluated vector generation, durable queue/workflow and separately isolated execution pool. Use existing D1 console as entry point only while its transactional/runtime limits meet the release profile; migrate financial/task authority deliberately before paid multi-tenant scale requires it. Do not operate contradictory D1/PostgreSQL financial masters.

occurrences.statement: One validated model route behind existing gateway, provider-approved authorization, secure tool broker, microVM isolation for hostile repository builds, test receipts, fenced attempts and operation reconciliation. Portable managed deployment, backups/restore rehearsal, telemetry and on-call runbook. Buy reliable primitives; own admission/evidence/review/authorization contracts. Kubernetes/Neo4j/Temporal may be phased in as measured workload needs the target architecture; do not incur the entire 100-cell operating cost for ten pilot teams.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Planning lower bound: founder/product owner, senior technical lead and full-stack/runtime engineer, with fractional independent security/test/design review. About 2.5–3.5 effective FTE and 16–24 weeks to qualified narrow pilot, assuming existing code is usable, hiring/grants are available and scope stays one stack/provider. Solo work may prototype faster but is not a credible production safety minimum. This is an estimate, not a promised date.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Lean cash illustration: $30k monthly team/tool/operations burn ×6 months = $180k, plus $25k setup/security/legal and 20% contingency = $246k. Round to approximately $250k–$350k to reach a narrow pilot with limited runway. Founder unpaid/deferred salary lowers cash while increasing opportunity/retention risk; document it. Recommended staffed route: about $55k monthly all-in burn ×6 plus $30k setup, with 20% buffer = $432k; plan $450k–$650k through pilot and early beta learning. These are assumed budgets, not vendor quotes or committed fundraising.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Minimum success gate: ten active design-partner teams, at least five using the verified loop repeatedly, actual permitted repo/model/worker/PR receipts, ≥70% acceptance of eligible narrow candidates in a predefined evaluation set, zero unresolved critical isolation defects, measured cost per accepted outcome, and buyers willing to pay. Retention/acceptance targets are hypotheses to qualify; sample size and task selection must be disclosed.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Phases are release/operating maturity, not universal calendar promises. Windows overlap by workstream; advancement requires evidence and enough cash. Headcounts are end-of-phase planning ranges, not automatic hiring commitments. Major enterprise controls begin before launch even though dedicated enterprise product expansion is phase 6.

Paid launch depends on live access, verified outcomes, isolation, billing/cost cap, support and recovery. Open marketplace depends on module security/evaluation/revocation, not only storefront design. Government depends on applicable qualified procurement/security controls and budget, not adding a Government tier button.

Contribution per job/account includes variable costs; early gross margin can be poor/negative because support/control-plane costs precede scale.

occurrences.statement: Observe → Understand → Map → Analyze → Predict → Simulate → Plan → Build → Test → Deploy → Measure → Learn → Improve → Evolve. Each traversal is a finite workflow with a deadline, spend cap, cancellation generation and accountable owner. Repetition is scheduled by policy; “forever” means sustained stewardship, not an unstoppable job.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Observation and mapping establish provenance and gaps. Prediction produces hypotheses. Simulation screens alternatives. Planning records risks, success criteria and permission scope. Build creates a candidate. Test compares a fixed baseline. Deploy is a scoped, reversible release. Measurement checks real outcomes and delayed harm. Learning stores the result, including failed or reverted releases. Evolution updates only the relevant capability version.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Candidate lifecycle: observed → proposed → curated → sandboxed → evaluated → approved → canary → promoted. Any pre-release state can become rejected or expired; canary/promoted can become rolled_back or suspended. State changes use compare-and-swap version and an idempotency key. Replaying an event cannot duplicate a release.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Existing policy may authorize automatic low-risk prompt, retrieval or workflow changes inside a sandbox and narrow canary. New data access, tools, execution grants, model providers, security controls, financial commitments and external side effects require the appropriate owner-controlled authorization. Agents cannot create permission by creating more agents. Child authority is the intersection of parent, template, target policy and current account grant. Evolution cannot weaken these intersections.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: This package is a target design. Existing bounded workers and static analyses do not implement this distributed evolution plane. All implementation backlog items remain open until their own acceptance evidence exists.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Capture successes, failures, observations, comparisons, simulations, experiments, peer review, user corrections, historical outcomes and resolved forecasts. Each signal records tenant, actor, task, capability version, source revision, timestamp, rights, sensitivity, outcome and confidence. Outcome metrics must distinguish task completion from actual user benefit. A positive click, an agent's confidence or a peer vote is not proof of correctness.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Changing system knowledge does not automatically modify provider model weights. Provider-hosted training requires a supported training interface and account rights; an OAuth identity alone does not grant inference or training. Begin with memory, retrieval and versioned procedures; treat weight changes as separately governed releases.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: For each skill and environment maintain accuracy, success/failure, innovation quality, forecast calibration, task quality, satisfaction and learning speed. Record numerator, denominator, sample interval, cohort, evaluator version and uncertainty. Accuracy is evaluated against independent outcomes; satisfaction is a separate subjective signal. Innovation measures adopted value after review, not idea count. Learning speed measures time and cost to sustained competency at a fixed benchmark.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Maintain profiles per language/framework/version/risk tier rather than a universal “smartness” score. Use minimum samples and interval estimates; mark missing evidence unknown. Compare matched task cohorts or randomized assignments to reduce selection bias. Specialization should follow demonstrated strengths while preserving exploration budgets for less-tested agents. Trust cannot be inherited by clones or purchased with knowledge credits.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Forecasts are scenarios until resolved. Simulated outcomes are labeled synthetic and cannot be counted as real-world wins. Learning from futures means learning from assumptions, sensitivity and later observed resolution. A diversity of credible evidence should outweigh repeated copies of the same claim.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: Agent genetics and autonomous capability creation
occurrences.statement: “DNA” is a versioned software manifest, not biological intelligence. An agent genome references five immutable module families: Knowledge DNA (sources and concepts), Reasoning DNA (planning/review policies), Skill DNA (typed capabilities), Workflow DNA (task graphs), and Decision DNA (decision rules and evidence thresholds). Identity, credentials, user consent, permissions, accumulated trust and vote eligibility are not inheritable traits.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A genome contains ID, semantic version, content hash, parent hashes, module hashes, applicability predicate, tool requirements, license/rights manifest, compatible AgentOS versions, evaluation manifest, risk tier, resource envelope, expiry/review date and signature. A trait names its purpose, inputs, outputs, dependencies, failure modes and rollback replacement. Parent links form an acyclic lineage graph. A release pins exact module hashes, never mutable “latest.”
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Mutation changes a candidate prompt, workflow, retrieval rule or skill configuration. Recombination selects compatible module versions from approved parents. A compatibility solver rejects incompatible tool contracts, contradictory decision rules, invalid licenses and missing evaluation. No permissions union is allowed. Behavioral cloning transfers tested procedures and approved knowledge references; it does not duplicate a human account or model identity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Evaluate on quality, safety, latency, cost, robustness and domain applicability. Maintain a Pareto frontier; a faster but less reliable candidate may be acceptable for drafts and unacceptable for migrations. Safety and privacy are hard constraints, not weighted tradeoffs. Compare to the exact current baseline and a stable reference benchmark. Preserve specialist diversity so one popular trait does not erase capability in rare environments.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Successful traits propagate through signed capability releases. Poor traits become deprecated within their failing context; keep failure evidence for audit and do not remove unaffected uses without analysis. A receiving swarm revalidates on its own environment. Rollback restores the previous genome and procedural versions; durable business side effects require explicit compensations.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A discovered framework, threat or platform creates a gap record. Deduplicate against existing expertise. If a reusable skill suffices, extend an existing candidate; otherwise propose a temporary specialist with narrow goals. Define training sources, tools, benchmarks, budget and retirement conditions. Spawn only under AgentOS quotas. Research, sandbox and evaluate before granting production task eligibility.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: New swarms require a measurable coordination need: independent skills, queue pressure or incident isolation. An agent can propose an investigation/emergency team; policy may automatically instantiate preauthorized templates. Novel executable tools and external access remain owner-controlled. Unknown technologies initially use read-only research experts. Expire unused specialists, archive permitted knowledge and release compute.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Pattern, lessons-learned, optimization, security, architecture and innovation libraries share one evidence envelope. Each entry has claim, evidence links, applicability, contrary evidence, rights, sensitivity, owner, version, quality status and review date. A lesson from one project improves another only when transfer is authorized and technically relevant. Tenant-private code, secrets, customer details and unique business strategies never enter a global pool by default.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Local → project → organization → consented global propagation is a controlled release pipeline. Redaction is insufficient where context reidentifies a tenant. Prefer general recipes supported by independently licensed/public evidence; require opt-in and privacy review for tenant-derived patterns. Aggregate metrics use minimum cohorts, suppression and a documented privacy mechanism where appropriate. Global indexes cannot bypass current project access. Withdrawal tracks all derived summaries, embeddings, training manifests and exports; completed weight training may require model retirement or retraining according to its deletion contract.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Represent evidence as entities, transformations as activities and responsible actors as agents using W3C PROV concepts. Record derivation DAGs, source revision hashes and policy versions. Assertions include confidence, evidence strength, valid time, transaction time and assertion type: observed, inferred, simulated or forecast. A derived answer must display its evidence and uncertainty; unsupported causal inference remains a hypothesis.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Graph evolution creates candidate relationship types, classifications and abstractions in a registry. A proposal specifies semantics, cardinality, tenant scope, migration and backward compatibility. Evaluate representative queries, false merges, entity-resolution accuracy and access filtering. Test shadow indexes before rollout. Additive changes can be automated under approved rules; breaking ontology/schema changes require owner-controlled release gates.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Never rename away historical meaning. Store ontology version on assertions and provide translation views. Preserve IDs while enriching classification. Entity resolution may propose a merge but cannot merge separate tenant entities or conflate similarly named services without evidence. Unsupported nodes connect to an owning scope and a gap marker; do not fabricate a relationship just to satisfy “nothing isolated.”
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Compare lexical, vector and graph retrieval using time-aware, access-filtered gold queries. Measure relevance, citation fidelity, coverage, latency and cost. Filtering occurs before candidate expansion and again before response assembly. Track derived-index watermarks; incomplete generations must be visible. A ranking candidate may not optimize clicks by burying security findings or stale-source warnings. Rollback selects a compatible index generation, not mixed schema fragments.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Cross-library subscriptions deliver version notifications, not uncontrolled source broadcasts. Subscribers validate applicability and grants before importing. Invalidated high-risk lessons generate affected-release queries and a remediation queue. Knowledge growth counts verified usable coverage after deduplication and withdrawal, not raw nodes or embeddings.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The evaluator belongs to an independent service identity. Hidden tests remain inaccessible to candidates. Keep time-separated and external challenge sets to detect contamination and benchmark overfitting. Count correlated clones as one evidence lineage. Repeat promising results on a fresh cohort. Report confidence intervals, effect size, adverse outcomes and cost, including inconclusive results. Multiple candidate search requires multiplicity control or independent final confirmation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Sandbox simulations screen architecture, security, deployment, business and UX alternatives. They do not certify production behavior. A digital twin records calibration error and model assumptions. Business experiments need an authorized real cohort before revenue claims become observed evidence. Stop immediately for privacy violations, unexpected privilege, destructive behavior or hard budget breach.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Evaluate plans against outcome-grounded criteria: correct decomposition, dependency coverage, uncertainty handling, evidence fidelity, recovery, collaboration and user value. Store concise decision rationale, cited evidence, tool traces and outcome attribution. Do not require storage of private chain-of-thought. Confidence alone is not a quality metric; a critic's assertion is itself evidence to evaluate.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use counterexample generation, independent review, alternative plans and causal diagnosis. Separate model limitations from retrieval, tool, permission and environment failures. Escalate disagreement when evidence cannot resolve it. A meta-policy candidate goes through the same independent gates; recursion depth and critique budget are finite. Optimize the cheapest process that sustains quality, not the longest debate.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Promote only if the candidate passes absolute harm constraints and the required improvement/noninferiority bounds against the frozen baseline. Cross-model portability is measured separately. Canary by scope with instant version rollback. A model change invalidates compatibility assumptions and triggers reevaluation. Never optimize a prompt to conceal uncertainty, bypass controls or manipulate satisfaction ratings.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: OPRO research supports candidate generation and evaluation as a useful pattern on studied tasks; it does not prove universal recursive self-improvement. Prompt optimization must be constrained by independent evaluation and operational boundaries.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: # Research, invention and future exploration
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Research queues prioritize expected information gain, user relevance, urgency and cost. A new paper is not automatically a platform dependency. Produce a dossier: problem, method, evidence, limitations, replication plan, rights, threat model, maturity and potential benefit. Reproduce only in isolated workers. Convert a discovery into a capability candidate through the normal evaluation and release pipeline.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Idea → evidence review → novelty/competitive search → feasibility → prototype → validation → adoption decision → monitored outcome. Record source attribution, contributor rights, prior art search scope, expected customer value, assumptions, failure modes and cost. “Patent concept” is a research label; patentability and ownership need qualified review. Do not represent an idea as patented or commercially validated.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Cluster duplicate ideas and preserve alternative designs. Rank by problem severity, evidence, feasible differentiation, time-to-value, risk and opportunity cost. Maintain separate portfolios for core platform, customer-specific and speculative research. An invention's success score depends on adopted outcomes, not number of generated pitches. Stop low-value work and preserve lessons.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Generate bounded ensembles across technology adoption, traffic, pricing, model availability, regulation, competitors and failure conditions. Each scenario stores assumptions, horizon, conditional outcomes, dependency model, random seed, simulator version and evidence. Thousands of runs use quotas, representative sampling and diversity selection rather than unlimited model calls. Separate Monte Carlo variation from fundamentally different structural futures.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Rank strategic paths by robustness, regret, downside exposure, reversibility and option value. Assign probabilities only where calibration is defensible; otherwise provide ranges and stress cases. Use backtesting and proper scoring such as Brier/log score for resolved events. Never count synthetic scenarios as accurate predictions. Long horizons widen uncertainty and should trigger flexible investments, not false precision.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Forecast time horizons align with the knowledge architecture's year 1/3/5/10 views. Future memory stores scenarios separately from factual history. Revision preserves original predictions and resolution criteria so accuracy cannot be improved by rewriting the past. Emerging market and threat signals open research tasks before any production action.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Represent departments, swarms, agents, tasks, responsibilities and communication as a versioned organizational graph. Measure queue wait, handoff failures, duplicated work, unresolved disagreement, skill gaps, user outcomes and spend. Propose department creation, merger, split, retirement or routing change with measurable goals and a counterfactual baseline.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Simulate first. Shadow new routing while old ownership remains authoritative. Canary on a bounded project cohort, drain leases, transfer knowledge references and verify responsibility coverage. Every task has one accountable owner even when many experts collaborate. Reporting reorganization does not change access policy; security boundaries remain explicit. Roll back if handoff error, starvation or quality worsens. Avoid oscillation using minimum evaluation windows, hysteresis and cooldowns.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Knowledge credits advise exploration priority inside already authorized and reserved budgets; they do not create or enlarge spending authority. Trust and influence reflect independently measured contributions; they cannot purchase credentials, vote slots or constitutional authority. Use decay and domain specificity where evidence becomes stale. Penalize gaming, fabricated discoveries and reciprocal-review rings. Preserve baseline opportunity for new specialists so incumbents do not monopolize all tasks.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Authority is assigned by policy and accountable ownership, not accumulated popularity. Credits are internal accounting, not money or financial assets. Cost ledgers charge model, worker, storage and review resources to tenant and experiment. Cooperation rewards reused verified work and reduced total cost, not message volume.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Track welfare proxies: verified task outcomes, user benefit, fairness of task allocation, concentration, resilience, spend and unresolved harm. Emergent behavior in a simulator is a hypothesis about coordination, not evidence of consciousness or actual organizational superiority. No simulator can grant agents control of real organizations. Simulated policies must pass independent runtime tests and authorized canaries.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Stress tests include faction formation, collusion, misleading reputation, runaway spawning, shared-provider failure, privacy leakage and expert loss. Isolation limits contagion; independent review reduces correlated failure. Run destructive scenarios only in simulation. The resulting artifact is a recommendation with evidence and uncertainty, not an unreviewable command.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Knowledge growth | New verified, accessible coverage minus invalidations |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Automation growth | Verified useful automation with stable harm rate |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Agent growth | Qualified capacity per resource unit, not instance count |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Discovery speed | Time to independently verified relevant finding |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: | Future readiness | Tested options and resilience against declared scenarios |
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Store raw metric, units, cohort, denominator, uncertainty, baseline, evaluator version and observation interval. Unknown evidence stays unknown. Normalize to fixed versioned anchors; retain historical raw series when anchors change. Publish coverage alongside scores. A summary index may use declared weights only where dimensions are sufficiently measured; critical safety failure invalidates the summary rather than being averaged away. Raw agent count and graph size are operational counters, not improvement rewards.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Protect users through explicit accountability, understandable control and appropriate owner consent. Protect data through least privilege, tenant isolation, residency, provenance and enforceable deletion. Protect systems through bounded execution, independent evaluation, reversible releases and emergency suspension. Promote truth through evidence, uncertainty and visible correction. Promote learning and innovation through permitted experimentation. Promote transparency and collaboration through inspectable decisions and interoperable contracts.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: These rules are versioned policy controlled by accountable human governance. Evolution agents cannot rewrite them, disable audits, expand their own grants or remove stop controls. Policy changes require documented rationale, independent review and owner approval appropriate to scope. Runtime enforcement is outside candidate-controlled code. The release controller fails closed when policy/evidence is missing or signatures do not verify.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: A emergency stop cancels new claims and incrementally fences active side effects. Preserve evidence, revoke compromised grants, roll back compatible releases and initiate incident response. Recovery requires root-cause evidence and a scoped restart; do not blindly retry a compromised loop. Audit override identity, scope, reason and expiry. NIST AI RMF informs risk management; this design is not a certification.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use open export formats, durable identifiers, migration registries, algorithm agility and key rotation. Support provider replacement, model retirement and tool deprecation. Maintain a compatibility matrix across AgentOS, genomes, schema, prompts, models and policy. Migrations are resumable, idempotent, dual-read where necessary and verified before old paths retire.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: # Contracts, scaling and implementation sequence
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Use events evidence.accepted, candidate.proposed, evaluation.completed, release.canary_started, release.promoted, release.rolled_back, discovery.withdrawn and ontology.generation_ready. Delivery is at least once; state transitions and transactional outbox provide effective idempotence. Dead letters remain scoped and inspected. WebSocket/SSE dashboards expose filtered status, spend, confidence, lineage and emergency controls, never private model reasoning.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: Target capacity inherits the production architecture; it is not achieved by this specification. Benchmark ingestion, evaluation throughput, derived-index lag, release-controller latency and withdrawal convergence. Set measured SLOs per class before broad launch. Metrics include queue age, evaluator disagreement, rollback rate, harm rate, cost per validated improvement and stale applicability. Compare costs to benefit before spawning new capacity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The accompanying reference guard tests validate design invariants using fixtures. They do not implement provider execution, independent evaluation services, microVM isolation or production self-healing. Track those in the existing UNFINISHED-WORK folder; architecture completion does not close them. Prompt 8 remains reserved for the user's next specification.

occurrences.section: Hostile review: AgentOS, knowledge, memory and evolution
occurrences.statement: Review date: 2026-10-09. Scope: the entire consolidated AgentOS, Knowledge and Evolution architectures, plus the AgentOS lifecycle contract and evolution reference guard. This is a design audit, not a claim that deployed services were penetrated, benchmarked or independently certified. The reviewer roles below are analytical perspectives, not a claim that a separately staffed external research organization reviewed the product.

occurrences.section: Verdict and strengths that must survive consolidation
occurrences.statement: The principal weakness is that many decisive safety guarantees remain prose or fixture booleans. Millions-scale coordination and useful self-evolution are not established by a manifest, reference guard or documentation check. The final blueprint should preserve the ambition while making qualified capability classes, transactional protocols, measured release criteria, revocation convergence and accountable owners executable. The following findings are design gaps unless explicitly marked contradiction or implementation blocker. No proposed resolution marks a production task complete.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-01 — lifecycle table, diagram and learning execution disagree
occurrences.statement: **Sources:** A / “Required lifecycle states”; AL / `transitions` and `activity_allowed_in`.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-01 — lifecycle table, diagram and learning execution disagree
occurrences.statement: The prose/table and JSON permit Created→Archived, Learning→Dormant, Active→Learning and Active→Archived, while the diagram omits these edges. More importantly, Learning requires an approved training/evaluation objective, but AL allows execution activities only in Active. An engineer following that contract can prevent a Learning principal from doing the very work needed to qualify.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-01 — lifecycle table, diagram and learning execution disagree
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** durable Learning permits only learning/evaluation activity classes under separate narrow grants. Busy/Reviewing/Collaborating remain display activities; their eligibility must include lifecycle plus task class, not an unconditional Active-only list. Training orchestration may alternatively be performed by an Active evaluator on an inactive candidate principal; select and document that pattern per learning mode. Generate diagram/table/API transitions from a canonical transition-and-guard registry. Every permitted edge needs entry, exit, effects, compensation and quiescence requirements.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-01 — lifecycle table, diagram and learning execution disagree
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** enumerate all allowed and forbidden transitions; execute learning qualification without granting ordinary production work; prove concurrent retirement blocks new learning dispatch; test diagram/contract parity.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-02 — global pattern admission is stronger than the propagation reference guard
occurrences.statement: The documented policy requires source rights, confidentiality review, current object access, recipient purpose, opt-in where applicable and withdrawal lineage. The helper accepts same-tenant transfer solely from `rightsCurrent`, or cross-tenant transfer from two booleans. Same-tenant is not the same as same-project/classification/purpose authorization. A global-consent flag is not an approved publication receipt or permission to send to any recipient.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-02 — global pattern admission is stronger than the propagation reference guard
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** treat the helper strictly as an incomplete illustrative fixture. Production propagation requires a signed publication/admission receipt, current source-access evaluation, destination scope/purpose policy, restricted lineage compatibility and withdrawal generation. Authorization must run on the receiving side too. Retain raw-source restrictions even when an artifact is generalized.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-03 — credits cannot fund actual exploration independently of money
occurrences.statement: A correctly states nonfinancial credits are not real usage/billing authority. E says credits fund exploration inside fixed budgets. That wording can be implemented as an exchange rate that authorizes spend through reputation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-03 — credits cannot fund actual exploration independently of money
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** credits influence allocation priority for already authorized and reserved budget; they never create, increase or transfer financial entitlement. A policy-controlled budget allocator may consider credit as one advisory input. Exact money reservations and tenant spending caps remain separate authoritative ledgers.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-03 — credits cannot fund actual exploration independently of money
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** arbitrarily inflate credits and verify no grant, vote slot, model call or spend cap increases; show allocation receipt references a pre-existing money reservation.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-05 — cross-cell budget and sponsorship transfers lack a crash-safe protocol
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** allocate unique transfer IDs and non-overlapping child reservation ceilings. Sender records prepared reservation, receiver records accepted allocation, sender records committed delegation; duplicates converge to the same receipt. Until reconciliation resolves unknown acceptance, funds remain unavailable to new work. Refund only after receiver proves cancellation/fence or no acceptance. The receiving cell cannot enlarge the root budget. This is an application protocol with ledger reconciliation, not a claim of universal distributed exactly-once delivery.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-06 — review independence is necessary but lacks an enforceable dependency model
occurrences.statement: ### AK-06 — review independence is necessary but lacks an enforceable dependency model
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-06 — review independence is necessary but lacks an enforceable dependency model
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** record reviewer dependency manifests: author involvement, template lineage, model family/revision, retrieval evidence origin, evaluation ownership and financial incentives. Maintain action-class independence policies with qualified deterministic checks and external evidence where possible. Require at least one materially different verification mechanism for high-risk changes; inability to satisfy the policy yields inconclusive/escalated. Never multiply confidence by reviewer count without a measured correlation model.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-06 — review independence is necessary but lacks an enforceable dependency model
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** cloned reviewers cannot fill independent slots; test a shared misleading source; require a compiler/test/control check to refute a unanimous model error; display unqualified independence honestly.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-08 — topology optimization can violate accountability during a live handoff
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** late result, active review, cancelled transfer and rollback during handoff; every task has exactly one effective owner, no duplicated authority and a valid reviewer path.

occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** maintain a connector/language/version/analysis-mode matrix stating supported syntax, evidence method, limits, required execution, quality slices and unavailable domains. Every graph/map and health score carries that matrix revision and coverage. Do not advertise complete vulnerability analysis from regex observations. Surface unsound and incomplete static analysis separately.

occurrences.section: AK-10 — supported parser and inference envelope must become a product contract
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** representative reflection/generated-code/polyglot repositories; unsupported syntax cannot silently disappear or produce confirmed missing-dependency findings; product copy matches actual qualified scope.

occurrences.section: AK-11 — withdrawal and retraction require a convergence contract
occurrences.statement: ### AK-11 — withdrawal and retraction require a convergence contract
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-11 — withdrawal and retraction require a convergence contract
occurrences.statement: The design correctly follows lineage but does not quantify the period in which dependent summaries, exports, cold indexes or trained variants remain usable. At billions of relationships, complete descendant recomputation cannot be instantaneous.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-11 — withdrawal and retraction require a convergence contract
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** maintain a small authoritative denied-source/withdrawal generation checked at evidence assembly and release dispatch. Immediately block use of affected references; background purge tracks stores, caches, exports, training manifests and required third-party requests with receipts. Set a measurable deny-enforcement target and separate physical cleanup objective per storage class. Model retirement/retraining obligations are explicit before any training on revocable data. Never promise deleting a source can erase externally downloaded copies.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-12 — derivation invalidation can become a graph-wide denial-of-service
occurrences.statement: A widely used erroneous lesson or public dependency may have enormous descendant fanout. Immediate recomputation competes with incident work, while serving stale derivations can enable unsafe effects.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-12 — derivation invalidation can become a graph-wide denial-of-service
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** priority lanes for authorization invalidation, critical safety retraction and ordinary freshness; compact dependency manifests; lazy validity checking plus bounded recompute. Pin effect prerequisites to fresh admitted evidence. Rate-limit adversarial revise/retract churn without delaying access denial. Isolate blast radius by library release and consumer cohort.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-12 — derivation invalidation can become a graph-wide denial-of-service
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** revoke a million-dependent pattern under load; prove protected operations fail closed, unaffected tenants remain available and progress/lag metrics stay truthful.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-16 — decision memory needs authority expiration and reversal effects
occurrences.statement: An accepted historic decision remains searchable, but must not authorize a later action after source, target, regulation, budget or accountable signer changes.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-16 — decision memory needs authority expiration and reversal effects
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** separate historic accepted-decision record from current effective policy/action authorization. Decision applicability has version, expiry/review date and dependency conditions. Reversal creates a new decision plus implementation obligations; do not silently erase the old rationale or assume reversal compensates deployed effects.

occurrences.statement: ## Research and evolution hostile review
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-17 — release fixture booleans are not verifiable attestations
occurrences.statement: The helper accepts caller-supplied booleans for independent evaluation, policy, rights and hard constraints. It does not verify signatures, expiry, evaluated candidate hash, cohort, metric thresholds, evaluator role or baseline still being deployed. Missing arrays can throw rather than deny. This is fine as a fixture but dangerous if promoted into production.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-17 — release fixture booleans are not verifiable attestations
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** production controller validates typed signed evaluation and policy receipts; exact candidate/baseline/evaluator/dataset hashes; freshness; scope; minimum cohort; prespecified improvement/noninferiority; authority epoch; compatibility and rollback readiness. All malformed inputs fail closed with typed error. Distinguish fixture checks from integration/security qualification in reports.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-18 — continual search needs a portfolio-level false-discovery budget
occurrences.statement: ### AK-18 — continual search needs a portfolio-level false-discovery budget
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-18 — continual search needs a portfolio-level false-discovery budget
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** evaluation registry tracks candidate search family, data exposure and test-set reuse; hold independent sealed final-confirmation cohorts. Apply prespecified sequential/multiple-comparison methods suited to the metric and allocation unit. Require durable improvements on realistic matched cohorts and a stable reference, not only a recently weakened baseline. Maintain diversity and rare-slice regression gates.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-19 — self-created expertise can launder an unverified vendor claim into a capability
occurrences.statement: ### AK-19 — self-created expertise can launder an unverified vendor claim into a capability
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-19 — self-created expertise can launder an unverified vendor claim into a capability
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** research maturity states: sourced claim, independently corroborated, reproduced, environment-qualified, adopted and monitored. Research experts remain research-only until competence qualification. Preserve negative replication and source limitations; prioritize user need rather than novelty volume. Do not auto-install tool dependencies from source text.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-19 — self-created expertise can launder an unverified vendor claim into a capability
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** fabricated method with credible source formatting, real paper with nonreproducing result and unsupported customer version; no production eligibility until appropriate tests pass.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-20 — evolution rollback is not sufficient for delayed or irreversible harm
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** distinguish code/config rollback, external compensation, data repair and irrecoverable harm. Canary release plan includes attribution window, delayed monitoring, maximum blast radius and adverse-outcome ownership. Security fixes may have justified noninferiority exceptions but cannot weaken current grants. Uncertain effect outcomes remain reconciliation blockers.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ### AK-21 — genome compatibility solver needs explicit constraint semantics

occurrences.section: AK-21 — genome compatibility solver needs explicit constraint semantics
occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** manifest includes typed interface versions, environmental predicates, dependency ranges resolved to hashes, data-right constraints, policy requirements and resource envelope. Solver returns a reproducible compatibility proof or unsatisfied constraints; unresolved behavioral compatibility requires environment tests. Never resolve a security/policy conflict by weighted fitness.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.section: AK-21 — genome compatibility solver needs explicit constraint semantics
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** contradictory decision modules, incompatible schema/embedding generation, withdrawn dependency and conflicting source rights fail admission; compatible recombination still undergoes behavior qualification.

occurrences.statement: ### AK-22 — future exploration needs falsifiability and no hindsight rewriting

occurrences.statement: **Resolution:** each scoreable forecast freezes event definition, horizon, probability/range, source time, resolution source and missing-data rules. Separate scored probabilistic forecasts, structural stress scenarios and speculative inventions. Report coverage and unresolved forecasts. Robust/reversible decisions may be useful without assigning unreliable probabilities to decade-scale AGI or quantum futures.

occurrences.section: AK-22 — future exploration needs falsifiability and no hindsight rewriting
occurrences.statement: **Gate:** backtest with source cutoffs; detect future-information leakage; unresolved predictions do not count as successes; original issued forecasts remain immutable.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: ### AK-23 — civilization metrics must reward user outcomes rather than organizational expansion

Retain swarm structure only where measured quality, cost, resilience or speed improves. Expose verified deliverables per dollar, user-benefit outcomes, dissent resolution, recurrence and concentration alongside internal scores. Simplification and safe retirement count as improvements.

occurrences.statement: Retain the three packages as detailed supporting designs, with this review's precedence decisions incorporated into the final Build Bible. The blueprint should say what is specified, what exists in the current code, what is tested only by fixtures, and what still requires real operational evidence. The platform is not currently qualified as a millions-agent autonomous engineering organization or a continuously self-evolving civilization. It can become more capable through staged, measured, authorized releases; the architecture must make that path testable rather than rhetorical.

occurrences.section: Business, product and experience hostile review
occurrences.statement: Review date: October 9, 2026. Scope: complete consolidated execution strategy and experience specification, financial inputs/calculation/results, and current-state register. Review lenses are hypothetical competitor, investor, founder and enterprise/product teams. No actual company, investor or customer endorsement is implied. Design requirements, arithmetic verification and commercial evidence are different categories.

Detailed anchors below name chapter files so future editors can locate decisions without relying on line numbers.

occurrences.statement: The opening workflow is coherent: inherited TypeScript/JavaScript repository → evidence-backed priority → bounded candidate → independent isolated validation → draft PR → retained outcome. The full civilization vision does not establish product-market fit. Commercial launch remains blocked on actual consent/provider/worker/PR evidence, production safety, metered commercial controls and buyer validation. A console, 47 domain definitions, 39 catalog connectors and architecture packages are not an operational engineering organization.
occurrences.review_note: Candidate obligation, not automatically a unique defect; repeated appendix/task statements retained.

occurrences.statement: The experience specification correctly separates permission from role modes, facts from forecasts, approval from deployment, and graph size from visible map size. It has not established whether an actual beginner can complete the workflow. Wireframes and contrast checks do not prove usable or accessible implemented journeys.

occurrences.statement: The previous model was mathematically internally reconciled but economically incomplete. occurrences.section: Acceptance sequence and final commercial verdict
occurrences.statement: First close live access/execution/reconciliation, current source rights, isolation and budgets. Next demonstrate one narrow high-value task with customer acceptance and independent evidence. Next verify resumable onboarding, exact-target review, accessibility and real cost receipts. Then run paid retained cohorts and revise entitlement/price/funnel/cash assumptions. occurrences.statement: This is the Prompt 8 hostile design review, not a penetration-test report, certification, live failover result or claim that the target platform has been implemented. The reviewer read the complete production chapters 01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 09, 10, 15, 16, 17 and 18, the core SQL/capability/event contracts, implementation status/completion documents, current-state and relevant unfinished-work chapters. Direct code inspection covers `db/schema.ts`, `db/store.ts`, `lib/jobs.ts`, `app/api/worker/route.ts` and `worker/runner.mjs`. Findings about those code paths are observations from source; they require executable regression fixtures before being dispositioned as fixed. OAuth implementation and every application route were not independently audited by this reviewer.

occurrences.statement: The present owner-private Sites/D1 application and the proposed regional PostgreSQL/Temporal/Kafka/Neo4j/Qdrant platform are different systems. The 94 previously recorded SQLite-backed acceptance/runtime checks do not establish cross-tenant isolation, model-provider consent, arbitrary application correctness, worker isolation, disaster recovery or production self-healing. Historical SHA references in architecture chapters describe checkpoints rather than today's application capability. `UNFINISHED-WORK/current-state.md` defines the implementation evidence boundary.

occurrences.section: Verdict from four hostile review teams

A database rollback cannot undo external writes. | Residency-scoped ownership consensus, monotonic fencing, operation intent/reconciliation and tested migration/recovery choreography. | Pause uncertain writes rather than admit a second writer or retry an unknown effect. |
